That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Über uns

Wir sind relyon
, ein wachsender Systemintegrator für moderne IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerke, Cloud, Automatisierung und KI.

Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen und Großkunden dabei, ihre IT sicher, leistungsfähig und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Dabei verbinden wir klassische IT-Infrastruktur mit modernen Cloud-, Automatisierungs- und AI-Technologien.

Intelligent Systems. Reliable Impact.

Deine Rolle

Wir suchen keinen System Engineer, der seit zehn Jahren immer dieselben Systeme administriert.

Wir suchen einen technisch starken Generalisten und High Potential
, der eine solide IT-Basis mitbringt, sich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeitet und KI selbstverständlich als Werkzeug nutzt
, um schneller zu lernen, Probleme zu analysieren, Lösungen zu entwickeln und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.

Du musst deshalb noch nicht jedes Produkt aus unserem Tech Stack bis ins letzte Detail kennen.

Wichtiger ist uns, dass du IT-Infrastrukturen verstehst, technische Zusammenhänge schnell erkennst und dich auch an Themen herantraust, mit denen du bisher noch nicht gearbeitet hast.

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht nur mit bestehenden Systemen. Du sollst aktiv mitgestalten, wie ein moderner System Engineer mit AI, Automation und intelligenten Tools arbeitet.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Du arbeitest generalistisch über verschiedene Bereiche moderner IT-Infrastruktur hinweg und entwickelst dich abhängig von deinen Stärken zunehmend zum technischen Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

Planung, Implementierung und Betrieb moderner IT-Infrastrukturen und hybrider Umgebungen

Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft 365
, Entra ID
, Intune
und Microsoft-basierten Kundenumgebungen

Monitoring und Management von Client- und Serverumgebungen mit NinjaOne

Analyse und strukturierte Lösung technischer Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Umfeld

Automatisierung wiederkehrender administrativer Prozesse, beispielsweise mit n8n, PowerShell, APIs oder AI-gestützten Workflows

Nutzung von Generative AI und Large Language Models (LLMs)
bei Troubleshooting, Recherche, Dokumentation, Scripting und Automatisierung

Entwicklung neuer Ansätze, wie wir AI und Automation im IT-Betrieb
sinnvoll einsetzen können

Technische Dokumentation und Weitergabe deines Wissens innerhalb des Teams

Mitarbeit an Kundenprojekten rund um Cloud, Netzwerk, Security, Modern Workplace und Managed Services

Unser Tech Stack

Abhängig vom jeweiligen Kunden und Projekt arbeitest du unter anderem mit:

Microsoft & Cloud

Microsoft 365

Microsoft Intune

Microsoft Azure

Windows Server

Automation & Operations

Monitoring- und RMM-Lösungen

AI

Large Language Models

AI-Assisted Troubleshooting

AI-gestützte Recherche und Dokumentation

AI Automation und intelligente Workflows

Wir erwarten ausdrücklich nicht
, dass du bereits in allen genannten Technologien Experte bist.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest

Deine technische Basis

Du hast eine solide Grundlage in der IT-Infrastruktur und verstehst, was hinter den Systemen passiert.

Idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit:

Microsoft 365 oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Umgebungen

Windows Server und Active Directory

Microsoft Azure oder hybriden Cloud-Infrastrukturen

Netzwerkgrundlagen wie TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN und Routing

Firewalls und IT-Security

Client-, Server- oder Endpoint-Management

Scripting oder Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit PowerShell, Python oder Low-Code-/No-Code-Tools

Eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration
, ein Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation ist hilfreich.

Entscheidender als dein Abschluss ist für uns aber, was du technisch verstehst und wie schnell du Neues lernen kannst.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du arbeitest AI-first

Für dich ist KI kein Buzzword und auch kein besseres Google.

Du nutzt AI beispielsweise, um:

technische Fehler systematisch zu analysieren

unbekannte Technologien schneller zu verstehen

Lösungswege zu entwickeln und kritisch zu überprüfen

PowerShell-Skripte oder Automationen zu erstellen

Dokumentationen effizienter aufzubauen

APIs und Systeme miteinander zu verbinden

repetitive Aufgaben zu automatisieren

.

Wenn du eine Technologie noch nicht kennst, ist deine erste Reaktion nicht:

„Damit habe ich noch nie gearbeitet.“

Sondern:

„Okay. Wie funktioniert das?“

Du hast Freude daran, neue Systeme auszuprobieren, dich selbstständig einzuarbeiten und technische Probleme wirklich zu verstehen.

Du bist Generalist

Du möchtest dich nicht ausschließlich auf einen einzelnen Hersteller oder ein einziges Spezialgebiet beschränken.

Du findest es spannend, Zusammenhänge zwischen Cloud, Netzwerk, Security, Endpoints, Automation und AI
zu verstehen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung

Du wartest bei einem Problem nicht darauf, dass dir jemand jeden einzelnen Schritt vorgibt.

Du recherchierst, testest, hinterfragst und holst dir Unterstützung, wenn sie sinnvoll ist.

Du brauchst bei uns keine zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung
.

Und du musst auch nicht jeden Punkt unseres Tech Stacks bereits beherrschen.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich auch Menschen, die vielleicht erst einige Jahre Berufserfahrung haben, aber technisch besonders schnell lernen, neugierig sind und durch den intelligenten Einsatz moderner Tools bereits heute deutlich über ihrem formalen Erfahrungslevel arbeiten.

mitbringst, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

eine technische Rolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum statt starrer Produktgrenzen

moderne Projekte rund um IT-Infrastruktur, Cloud, Security, Automation und AI

die Möglichkeit, neue Technologien nicht nur auszuprobieren, sondern produktiv einzusetzen

gezielte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen

moderne technische Ausstattung

hybrides Arbeiten mit drei Tagen im Office und zwei Tagen mobilem Arbeiten

betriebliche Altersvorsorge

Corporate Benefits

Klingt nach dir?

Vielleicht bist du heute bereits System Engineer, IT Administrator, IT Infrastructure Engineer, Microsoft 365 Administrator, Network Engineer, Cloud Engineer oder Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration
.

Vielleicht passt aber auch keiner dieser klassischen Titel hundertprozentig zu dir.

Wenn du eine solide technische Grundlage hast, dich schnell in neue Systeme einarbeitest und heute schon selbstverständlich mit AI und Automation

Du entwickelst und optimierst Testkonzepte

Ein Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Görlitz

Praxiserfahrung mit mindestens einem etablierten Testfallportfoliomanagementtool, beispielsweise Xray, Zephyr, Octane, Tosca
Erfahrung mit Frontend- und API-Test

Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau C1, da Kundenkommunikation, Workshops und Projektdokumentation überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfinden

Eine gültige Arbeitsberechtigung für Deutschland spätestens zum Eintritt

Das ist ein Plus

Eine ISTQB-Advanced-Level Zertifizierung
Kenntnisse in einer relevanten Programmiersprache, beispielsweise Java, TypeScript/JavaScript oder C#
Kenntnisse im Performance-, Security- oder Mobile-Testing
Erfahrung in Beratungs- oder Kundenprojekten

Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Wenn du Testautomatisierung technisch beherrschst, Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest und zu unserem Arbeitsmodell passt, sollten wir trotzdem miteinander sprechen.

SIEVON ist ein etabliertes IT-Beratungsunternehmen aus Görlitz. Unsere Wurzeln liegen in der Softwarequalität, daher unterstützen wir heute Unternehmen in den Bereichen Qualitätssicherung, Testautomatisierung, Softwareentwicklung und der agilen Zusammenarbeit. Softwarequalität entsteht für uns durch klare Ziele, durchdachte Prozesse, passende technische Lösungen und Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen. Deshalb verbinden wir methodische Beratung mit praktischer Umsetzung und begleiten unsere Kunden von der ersten Anforderung bis zur funktionierenden Software. Dabei hinterfragen wir bestehende Ansätze, teilen unser Wissen und entwickeln uns gemeinsam weiter. SIEVON steht für fachlichen Anspruch, verlässliche Zusammenarbeit und ein Team, in dem unterschiedliche Erfahrungen und Stärken zusammenkommen. Unser Standort in Görlitz ist dabei mehr als eine Adresse: Hier arbeiten wir gemeinsam, tauschen uns persönlich aus und entwickeln unser Unternehmen Schritt für Schritt weiter.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

We are seeking a Solutions Architect to own and drive the technical architecture of our Environmental Accounting product area.

This is a hands-on architecture role, ideal for a technically strong engineer who is ready to take ownership of system design, technical direction, and engineering standards while still contributing to the codebase.

You will play a key role in ensuring the engineering teams consistently deliver value to customers through high-quality, reliable, and scalable SaaS solutions. You will also act as the accountable technical authority for the product area within the wider organization, including Product Management, Engineering leadership, and senior stakeholders.

This role requires a strong software engineering background (ideally .NET / C# or Node.js) with the ability to stay close to the code while shaping architecture and influencing across teams. You should be comfortable working in an environment with minimal unnecessary formality, where success is driven through direct communication, trust, and continuous improvement.

Critically, this role demands deep, demonstrable proficiency with AI.
We are transforming how we build software and what we build. You will be expected to work fluently within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), to architect and deliver agentic AI solutions within our products, and to bring genuine hands-on experience with agentic coding tools — Claude Code in particular. This is not a theoretical or advisory expectation: we are looking for someone who uses these tools daily, understands their failure modes, and can raise the whole engineering organization's capability with them.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve the technical architecture

Define, document, and evolve the target architecture for Sphera's Corporate Sustainability product, covering design, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability
Ensure architectural decisions are recorded, justified, and clearly communicated using appropriate modelling and documentation approaches
Build a culture of technical excellence, sound design thinking, and continuous improvement across the engineering teams
Act as the key technical point of reference for the product area, ensuring alignment with broader engineering and business goals

AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC)

Champion and embed an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle across the product area, applying AI meaningfully at every stage — requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support
Define what "good" looks like for AI-assisted engineering: prompting and context practices, human review and verification gates, quality bars, and guardrails for what must never be delegated to a model
Measure the impact of AI on delivery throughput, defect rates, and engineering experience, and iterate on practices based on evidence rather than hype
Establish policy and standards for the safe, secure, and compliant use of AI tooling, including handling of proprietary code, customer data, and intellectual property

Agentic AI solution development

Architect and deliver agentic AI capabilities within Sphera's Environmental Accounting product, taking them from prototype through to production
Design robust agentic systems: tool and function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls
Own the non-functional dimensions of AI features — evaluation and testing strategy, observability, latency, cost management, model selection and versioning, and graceful degradation
Address AI-specific risk directly: hallucination and grounding, prompt injection and data exfiltration, access control on agent tooling, auditability, and responsible AI considerations
Maintain a working knowledge of the fast-moving AI landscape and make pragmatic build-versus-buy and model-selection recommendations

Hands-on technical leadership

Contribute directly to the codebase where it has the greatest impact, using modern software engineering practices
Work hands-on with Claude Code and comparable agentic coding tools as a daily part of the role, and set the standard for how the wider team uses them effectively
Extend and tailor the team's AI tooling — for example project context files, custom commands, subagents, hooks, and MCP server integrations with internal systems
Provide deep technical guidance in .NET / C# or Node.js environments
Prototype and validate architectural approaches, spiking on high-risk or high-uncertainty areas ahead of delivery
Maintain a strong, current understanding of system design, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and software quality

Delivery and execution

Partner closely with Product Management to translate requirements into clear, actionable technical designs and engineering outcomes
Ensure architectural work supports consistent, high-quality SaaS releases aligned with business priorities
Identify and remove technical blockers, proactively resolving design and integration issues impacting team performance
Balance long-term architectural health against near-term delivery needs, making trade-offs explicit

Technical influence and enablement

Raise the technical capability of engineers through design reviews, pairing, and mentoring
Upskill the team in AI-assisted engineering, coaching engineers to use agentic tooling with judgment — and to critically review what it produces
Set and champion engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, and security
Have open, honest, and sometimes challenging technical conversations to drive better outcomes
Foster a culture of informal, direct communication and trust across the teams

Process and continuous improvement

Take ownership of technical practices and evaluate their effectiveness in delivering outcomes
Apply critical judgment to existing designs and processes and propose improvements where needed
Identify and drive down technical debt, prioritizing work that materially improves reliability and speed of delivery
Ensure the teams operate efficiently without unnecessary bureaucracy, while maintaining appropriate engineering discipline

Stakeholder engagement

Act as the primary technical voice for the product area to internal stakeholders and customers where required
Maintain strong working relationships with Product, Engineering, and wider business functions
Ensure transparency in technical direction, risks, and trade-offs

Requirements

Core engineering

7+ years of software engineering experience
3+ years in an architecture, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity
Strong hands-on development experience in .NET / C# or Node.js
Proven experience architecting and delivering SaaS or enterprise software products at scale
Strong experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), distributed systems, and API design
Strong ability to translate product requirements into technical designs and execution
Demonstrated experience in mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without direct authority
Highly desirable: technical proficiency with Databaricks, Sql Server and Azure SQL

AI Proficiency (essential)

Demonstrable hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent agentic coding tools, used routinely on real production codebases rather than experimentally
Practical experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), applying AI across design, implementation, testing, review, and documentation — and able to speak credibly about where it works, where it does not, and why
Solid working understanding of agentic AI design patterns — tool/function calling, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design — with the appetite to take them into production
Working knowledge of the current LLM landscape and the judgment to select models and approaches appropriate to the problem, cost, and latency profile
Experience defining evaluation, testing, and observability strategies for non-deterministic AI systems
Understanding of AI-specific security and governance concerns, including prompt injection, data leakage, access control on agent tooling, and responsible AI practice
Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a force multiplier, balanced with the engineering rigor to know when not to use it

Desirable

Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI solutions into production, including tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design
Experience building integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
Experience introducing AI tooling and practices across an engineering organization, including the change management involved
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, low-formality, high-accountability environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience working in global or cross-functional organizations is beneficial

In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, security, scaling, and daily operations of our edge and cloud infrastructure. You will bridge the gap between development and operations by implementing high-velocity CI/CD pipelines, advanced container orchestration with Kubernetes (AKS), and modular Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Infrastructure & Container Orchestration

Pipeline Engineering: Build and optimize end-to-end continuous integration and deployment workflows across both Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions.

About The Role

Implement and manage software solutions that provide accurate and efficient analysis of test runs

Correlate test coverage data with code changes, runtime execution, and trace data for comprehensive reporting
Maintain a strong focus on scalability, usability, and reliability in platform design to support a growing organization of stunning engineers
Define testing strategies in partnership with cross-functional teams - producing documentation on frameworks and troubleshooting patterns that internal teams rely on

Must Haves

A stunning software engineer with experience working on developer platform, platform services, or productivity-tooling teams - energized by unblocking other engineers and amplifying their throughput
A meticulous software designer who researches and documents technical tradeoffs clearly and concisely
Deep understanding of distributed systems, service design, and automation platforms (CI/CD, test orchestration)
Hands-on GenAI fluency - daily use in your engineering workflow, plus experience shipping LLM-powered systems, ideally for developer users
Ability to independently drive organization-wide solutions and manage complex technical projects from conception to completion
Ability to synthesize complex technical information and communicate it effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience establishing strong testing culture, including proficiency with popular test frameworks, code coverage tools, continuous integration systems, and post-deployment verification methods (healthy contempt for flaky tests is a plus)

Build secure, scalable software as a consultant across defense, automotive, and telecom. Whether your strength is .NET, C++, applications, or Azure, we’d like to hear from you.

Your assignments will vary in technology, scope, and working setup. Depending on the project, you may work at a client’s site, from a Knowit office, or remotely. The solutions range from consumer products to complex industrial systems, giving you opportunities to apply your experience across different technical domains.

You might build scalable backend services in C# and .NET, develop applications, work with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, or solve challenges closer to industrial systems. Some assignments involve environments with high security requirements, including the defense industry.

Collaboration and knowledge sharing are central to the role. You will work alongside colleagues and clients, take responsibility for your delivery, and contribute ideas throughout the development process. As your interests and expertise evolve, you can explore new technologies and develop in a direction that makes sense for you.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You are an experienced software developer with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

Software development in C# and .NET.
Development in C++.
Backend or application development.
Cloud platforms, preferably Azure and the Microsoft ecosystem.
Testing at the unit, integration, or system level.
Development in environments with high security requirements, such as the defense industry.

We do not expect you to match every item. What matters is that you can contribute solid development experience, enjoy working with others, and take responsibility for your work. Curiosity and a willingness to keep learning will help you thrive as technologies, assignments, and customer needs evolve.

What can you expect from us?

Professional development is part of everyday work. In addition to courses and formal training, you will build knowledge through collaboration, workshops, seminars, and conversations with colleagues from different technical backgrounds.

Close dialogue with your manager helps shape assignments that support your experience, interests, and continued growth. You will have room to explore new technologies, share ideas, and influence how we work.

You will join an inclusive workplace that values openness, community, and continuous improvement. We also recognize the importance of a healthy balance between work and personal life. Workshops, seminars, after-work gatherings, and other shared activities provide opportunities to connect both professionally and socially.

Does this sound like a place where your experience and curiosity could make a difference? Send us your application and tell us which areas of software development interest you most. We look forward to learning more about you.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

jobs.description:
DevOps/Platform Engineer – Technology Frameworks

We are building the foundational infrastructure and platform services that power the next generation of Sectra's medical imaging and healthcare solutions. This role is for a software/devops engineer who thrives on learning, adapts quickly to new challenges, and cares deeply about building reliable, secure, and scalable systems that enable all our product teams to deliver better solutions for healthcare.

You will design and deliver production-grade platform services and infrastructure while leveraging modern AI tools and techniques to accelerate development and enhance system capabilities. Your work ensures that whether it's logging, edge computing, monitoring, or performance optimization, our platform services are rock-solid, efficient, and enable seamless integration across the entire Sectra ecosystem.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain high-quality platform services and infrastructure used across all Sectra product areas
Apply AI tools (e.g., code assistants, code generators) responsibly to increase velocity without compromising quality, security, or cost
Collaborate with product teams, architects, and end-users to translate infrastructure requirements into robust, scalable solutions
Own features end-to-end: design, implementation, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment
Implement and uphold strong engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, performance profiling, reliability standards
Work with modern distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and observability patterns (metrics, logging, tracing, SRE practices)
Administer and optimize Linux-based infrastructure, including system configuration, performance tuning, scripting and troubleshooting
Continuously learn: evaluate new tools, frameworks, and AI capabilities; share knowledge across the team and the broader organization

Core abilities:

Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures/algorithms, concurrency, networking, API design, distributed systems, software architecture
Strong Linux systems expertise: command-line proficency, shell scripting (Bash), system administration, networking, process management, and troubleshooting in production environments
Proficiency in one or more languages used for high-performance backend and infrastructure development (e.g., C#, Typescript, C++, Go) and modern tooling
Experience with cloud services, containers, and CI/CD (AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, or serverless)
Reliability and observability mindset: automated testing, monitoring (metrics/logs/traces), performance awareness, and SRE practices
Security and privacy literacy (secure coding, handling sensitive data, infrastructure security)
Curiosity and learning agility; ability to adapt to new domains, tools, and AI workflows
Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, cross-functional approach
Required: Humor and strong academic record from university and upper secondary school; please include transcripts or grade summaries in your application

Nice to have:

Experience building platform or infrastructure services that support multiple downstream consumers
Strong foundation in system design, scalability, and cost optimization (FinOps)
Advanced Linux expertise: kernel tuning, security hardening, configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef), or experience with multiple Linux distributions
Experience with logging systems, monitoring platforms, or observability infrastructure
Familiarity with healthcare IT standards and constraints (compliance, data handling, interoperability)
Frontend experience that complements backend work, or infrastructure tooling/dashboards
Pursue passions outside of work, whether in sports, music, the arts, or unique hobbies

,

At Sectra, we hire for attitude and ability – train for skill. This means who you are is more important than your previous experiences. There are a few core abilities that are central for any role. We always look for your willingness and ability to learn and take on new tasks fast, utilize previous experiences and quickly grasp new information. We also want you to have a strong analytical mindset, since we consider your ability to understand, break down and solve problems very important. We also look for good communicators who have the ability to interact with colleagues, partners and customers in an effective, clear and constructive way.

Why this role is more than a job

Your work will have a direct impact on every product team at Sectra and the clinicians and patients they serve. By building reliable, performant, and secure platform services, you enable our healthcare solutions to scale, adapt, and ultimately improve diagnostics and care. If you're motivated by the responsibility of building the backbone that others depend on, and you believe that great engineering done with care and precision matters, you'll feel at home here.

What We Offer

Mission-driven work in a domain that matters – the infrastructure underpinning healthcare innovation
Time and budget for learning and professional development
An engineering culture that values quality, reliability, security, and impact

Collaborative, cross-functional teams with mentorship and growth paths
Exposure to modern infrastructure challenges at the scale that healthcare demands

If you're curious to learn more about how we innovate and deliver customer value, visit our Product Development Page for further insights.

About The Company

Sectra develops and sells cutting-edge solutions for medical IT and cybersecurity. We help hospitals and those training future healthcare personnel to improve their efficiency so that patients can receive better care. We also support defense, authorities, and critical social functions to secure their communication against eavesdropping and protect their systems against unauthorized access. This is how we create conditions for a healthier and safer society.

One thing that identifies us at Sectra is our customer obsession — our ability and willingness to understand, create value for, and stand up for our customers. This shared priority is at the core of our culture. Our customers describe this as having the knowledge to meet expectations, the passion to exceed them. As we hire for attitude and ability — train for skill, we happily expand your knowledge if you bring the passion and willingness to learn.

In addition to these abilities, we also want you to:

Have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within engineering, IT or similar with a strong academic record
Have a strong interest in technology and software development
Be a team player eager to collaborate with your team members on daily development and operation tasks.
Be fluent in Swedish and English both verbally and written
Value customer contact and thrive in a fast-paced technological environment

We consider it a great asset if you:

Have experience of software development in agile technologies
Speak more languages than those required above
Have interests besides school/work, such as sports, music, creative arts, outdoor living or board gaming for example
Don't like to sit in unnecessary meetings, we prefer to think and develop software together

Other information:

The goal is for the right candidate to start as soon as possible.

We recruit on an ongoing basis. This means we encourage you to apply or contact us as soon as possible.

Depending on the role, a mandatory background security screening might be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this. Learn more about our recruitment process here.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
You’re an experienced AI architect who wants to turn applied AI into scalable, production-grade systems while helping clients create tangible business value.

As a senior consultant, you will work across the full lifecycle of applied AI, from strategy and architecture to implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. You will help clients understand how AI affects their products, workflows, and technical systems, then turn those insights into solutions that are scalable, observable, and trustworthy.

Your time will be divided between client assignments and Knowit Connectivity’s AI Advisory Team. Together with senior AI specialists, architects, and business leaders, you will shape AI strategy, develop internal capabilities, evaluate emerging technologies, and establish practical ways of working with AI across the organization.

Your work may include:

Designing AI-native architectures and intelligent systems
Building and deploying LLM-based applications and RAG solutions in production
Creating agent-based workflows and autonomous system behaviors
Defining governance, observability, monitoring, and evaluation strategies
Integrating AI into existing products, platforms, and business processes
Guiding clients through technical and organizational decisions involving performance, reliability, cost, and control

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

You bring senior-level, hands-on experience in applied AI and can move comfortably between strategic discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation. You also understand the demands of consulting and can help clients navigate both technical and organizational challenges.

We believe your background includes several of the following:

Building production applications with large language models
Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector databases, and complex information sources
Agent frameworks and orchestration platforms
System architecture, distributed systems, and large-scale software development
Python or a comparable programming language
Azure, AWS, or GCP, including evaluation, monitoring, and optimization of AI systems

Experience in enterprise architecture, platform engineering, or data engineering is highly valuable. You stay curious as the AI landscape evolves, apply new technology pragmatically, and recognize that strong AI systems require more than a successful prototype.

What can you expect from us?

You will solve real business problems with clients at different stages of AI maturity, from early exploration to implemented solutions. The assignments offer variety across projects and industries, giving you opportunities to build both breadth and depth over time.

Knowledge sharing is part of the everyday engineering culture. You will collaborate with experienced colleagues, influence client solutions, and contribute directly to how Knowit develops its AI capabilities and offerings. A formal development roadmap makes continuous AI learning and capability building part of your professional growth.

Application

If you have built real solutions with LLMs and want to help shape how AI is applied across engineering, products, and organizations, we would like to hear from you. Submit your application and tell us about the experience and perspective you would bring to the role.

About Knowit

Work with us at Knowit Connectivity, where we develop technically advanced systems within embedded and connected solutions. With us, you will work on complex products alongside experienced engineers on assignments at the forefront of technology.

Knowit is a Nordic consultancy that helps companies, public sector organizations, and businesses succeed in digital transformation. With expertise in software development, AI, cybersecurity, cloud services, digital customer experiences, and management consulting, we create solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and human-centered society.

We are approximately 3,700 employees working across our business areas – Solutions, Experience, Connectivity, Insight, and Products – primarily in the Nordics, as well as in Poland, Serbia, and Germany.

We don’t wait for the future. We build it.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We are currently recruiting on behalf of a leading global technology and transformation organisation for an experienced Senior .NET Architect
to join a major client engagement in Dublin.

This is a senior technical architecture role for an experienced .NET professional who enjoys shaping complex software solutions, influencing technical direction and working closely with engineering teams and business stakeholders. You’ll play a key role in defining modern .NET and Microsoft Azure
solutions, ensuring they are scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with wider business objectives.

The Opportunity

As Software Architect, you’ll take ownership of solution-level architecture across new software development initiatives. You’ll work closely with product, project and technical stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, while providing architectural leadership to development teams.

The role offers the opportunity to work with modern Microsoft technologies, including Azure PaaS
, and to influence the evolution of software platforms within a complex enterprise environment.

What you'll be doing

Define and design software architectures that meet business, functional and non-functional requirements.
Make architectural decisions covering scalability, performance, security, resilience, maintainability and accessibility
.
Translate business and technical requirements into practical, scalable software solutions.
Lead architectural discussions with product managers, project managers, developers, technical leads and other stakeholders.
Establish and promote software architecture standards, patterns and best practices.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Review designs and code to ensure solutions adhere to agreed architectural and engineering standards.
Identify technical risks, dependencies and challenges, developing appropriate mitigation strategies.
Evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks and tools in line with the wider technology strategy.
Contribute to the software development roadmap and support proof-of-concept initiatives where appropriate.
Support development teams with complex technical issues and troubleshooting when required.
Mentor and coach developers and other technical team members, helping to raise engineering capability.
Ensure software development and implementation align with organisational standards and governance.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a strong .NET/Azure technical architect
with a proven track record of designing and delivering complex software solutions in an enterprise environment.

Essential experience

Extensive commercial experience with C#, .NET Framework and modern .NET
.
Strong practical experience designing and developing solutions on Microsoft Azure
.
Strong understanding of Azure PaaS
services and cloud development patterns.
Proven experience designing complex, scalable and maintainable software systems.
Strong knowledge of software architecture patterns, development principles and engineering best practices.
Experience with SQL Server and Entity Framework
.
Strong understanding of REST APIs and API-led integration
.
Experience with Azure DevOps
and modern software delivery practices.
Familiarity with SonarQube
and code-quality practices.
Experience considering non-functional requirements (NFRs)
including performance, security, scalability and resilience.
Awareness of accessibility standards
and their application within software solutions.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence stakeholders at different levels.
Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to software development teams.

Desirable experience

Experience with front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS and jQuery
.
Experience working within large-scale enterprise or transformation programmes.
Experience establishing or evolving software architecture standards and governance.
Experience with proof-of-concept development and technology evaluation.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join a significant technology transformation environment where you'll have genuine scope to influence architecture, shape technical direction and work on complex enterprise solutions
.

You'll work alongside experienced engineering and technology professionals, with exposure to modern Microsoft technologies and the opportunity to contribute beyond individual projects.

Permanent full time position. Three days a week on site in Dublin
. Candidates must be eligible to work in Ireland/EU.

Salary dependent on candidate experience. Benefits: Annual Bonus Scheme. Contributory Pension. Private Medical Insurance. Life Assurance & Long-Term Disability. Employee Assistance Programme. 22 days annual leave + 10 public holidays. Relocation package. Continuous Learning & Development. Access to extensive training & certification resources. Lunch & Learn sessions. Additional perks including company discounts, on-site parking, and bike-to-work scheme.

For more information, please contact David Coyle
at 01 635 1748
or email david@methodius.com

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager - Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement (IRE)
jobs.description:
Reports To:
Head of IT – Platform Engineering
Direct Reports:
3-5
Location:
Citywest Business Campus (hybrid / 3 days per week in office)

About the role

The Platform Engineering Manager - Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement will lead architecture, cloud strategy, and network services across Inizio's corporate IT estate. You will set technical direction, governs standards, and lead senior engineers and architects designing solutions for the wider Platform Engineering organisation.
You will lead Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement and ensure Inizio's enterprise architecture remains consistent, scalable, secure, and supportable. You will translate technology strategy into practical engineering direction and develop a team operating as a true Centre for Enablement.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture Governance
Set engineering standards, architectural direction, and quality expectations across Inizio's enterprise platform estate.
Oversee architecture governance, ensuring you approve, and document solution designs through the appropriate processes.
Maintain reference architectures, technology standards, and Architecture Decision Records across cloud, network, identity, observability, and integration domains.
Assess the latest technologies and vendor capabilities, providing clear recommendations for Inizio's environment.
Embed security, resilience, supportability, and cost effectiveness into all architecture and engineering outputs.

Cloud Enablement & C4E Leadership
Lead Inizio's Centre for Enablement model, delivering reusable patterns, landing zones, golden paths, and engineering guardrails.
Oversee the cloud enablement strategy, driving Azure and AWS adoption following standards, security requirements, and the IT roadmap.
Oversee cloud engineering delivery across Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automation, and governance.
Provide leadership across the cloud and platform toolchain, including Azure, AWS, Entra ID, Boomi, ServiceNow integrations, and related controls.
Manage cloud vendor and managed service partner relationships.

People Management & Development
Manage senior engineers and architects through regular 1:1s, goals, performance reviews, and development conversations.
Build and sustain a collaborative team culture.
Identify skills gaps and develop plans to address them through recruitment, training, or professional development.
Act as a technical mentor across Platform Engineering.
Support workforce planning and succession activity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Roadmap
Shape and communicate the roadmap for the Design Engineering & Cloud Enablement with the Head of IT – Platform Engineering.
Translate business, security, architecture, and operational demand into priorities, reusable patterns, and standards.
Represent the function in architecture governance, service design, transition, and senior leadership forums.
Produce roadmaps, business cases, standards, and technical briefings to support decision-making.

Delivery & Operational Oversight
Ensure engineering delivery oversees work delivered to agreed time, quality, risk, and scope expectations.
Ensure architecture and cloud changes are governed, assessed, and ready for operational handover.

About you

Essential Experience
Experience in technical management or lead architecture within a complex enterprise IT environment.
Experience across Azure, AWS, enterprise networking, Entra ID, Boomi, and ServiceNow-aligned delivery and governance.
Experience leading senior technical teams across architecture, cloud, networks, or platform engineering.
Track record delivering cloud adoption, architecture transformation, or platform standardisation in a multi region enterprise.
Experience with reference architectures, design standards, service transition controls, and formal architecture review processes.
Experience operating in a Centre for Enablement, platform engineering, or reusable pattern model.

Qualifications
Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent senior-level professional experience.
Senior cloud or architecture certification expected, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional Cloud Architect, TOGAF, or equivalent.
Additional qualifications in security, networking, IT service management, project delivery, or cloud financial management are advantageous, including AZ-500, CCNP, CISSP, ITIL, PRINCE2, FinOps, or equivalent.

Skills & Attributes
Credible technical leader able to set direction across cloud architecture, platform engineering, enterprise networking, identity, automation, observability, and security by design.
The ability to build, coach, motivate, and hold senior engineers and architects accountable for delivery, quality, and professional growth.
Can explain complex architecture choices, trade offs, risks, and benefits to senior, operational, security, finance, and technical team members.
Strategic and commercially aware, able to oversee cost, resilience, risk, compliance, vendor selection, platform investment, and long-term total cost of ownership.
Delivery-focused; able to balance governance with enablement and push adoption of reusable patterns, guardrails, automation, and continuous improvement.

Core competencies
Technical Leadership – Sets a credible technical direction and earns the respect of senior engineers and architects.
Can connect engineering decisions to the broader organisational technology strategy.
People Development – Invests in building team capability and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work.
Communication & Influence – Articulates complex technical ideas for varied audiences and builds effective stakeholder relationships.
Delivery Focus – Drives engineering outcomes with pace and quality.
Collaboration – Works as a genuine partner with the other Technical Managers and the Head of IT to deliver Platform Engineering as a unified function.
Commercial Awareness – Makes engineering decisions with an understanding of cost, risk, and business impact.

About Inizio

At Inizio, we're a global team motivated by a shared purpose: to reimagine health. Formed in 2022, we unite decades of experience and expertise with data, technology, and AI to create tailored solutions that drive Intelligent Commercialization™ at every stage of the journey - from discovery to post-launch.
Our global network of over 10,000 experts operates across 50 countries, supporting clients with strategic insight, medical excellence, creative engagement, and real-world delivery. We work with the world's leading health and life sciences businesses to solve complex challenges and accomplish meaningful outcomes for our clients and patients.
What sets Inizio apart is our people - and we believe everyone should excel. Here, you're encouraged to reimagine your possibilities: to grow, to be curious and to make change happen. We value your individuality, support your development, and celebrate your ambition. If you're ready to push boundaries and accelerate your career, Inizio is the best place to be.

Our Pledge

At Inizio, we value inclusivity, recognize the power of diversity and inspire the next generation of change-makers. We are an equal opportunities employer. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity, equity and inclusion. We aim to recruit from a diverse slate of candidates and foster an environment that provides the right conditions for long-term success. We welcome all applications. We consider them regardless of race, color, religion, or belief. We also consider them regardless of gender, gender identity, age, national origin, marital status, military veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, and physical or mental disability.

Artificial Intelligence

Inizio may use AI technologies to support certain aspects of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions at Inizio are made by our human recruiting team. We are committed to fair, inclusive, and human-led hiring practices.

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

Goforella pääset työskentelemään projekteissa, jotka vaikuttavat aidosti satojen tuhansien suomalaisten arkeen ja hyvinvointiin. Voit hypätä mukaan esimerkiksi terveydenhuollon, varhaiskasvatuksen tai liikennetoimialan kehitys- ja uudistushankkeisiin. Palvelemme myös yksityisen sektorin asiakkaita esimerkiksi teollisuudessa, jossa autamme tuotteiden elinkaaren digitalisoinnissa sekä tuotanto- ja informaatioteknologioiden yhdistämisessä. Julkisen sektorin asiakkaitamme ovat esimerkiksi Verohallinto ja KEHA-keskus, ja yksityiseltä puolelta muun muassa Metso ja Hiab.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset

Rakentamaan moderneilla teknologioilla ratkaisuja, joilla on konkreettista yhteiskunnallista merkitystä.
Työskentelemään itseohjautuvasti osana ketterää tiimiä läheisessä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden kanssa.
Kehittymään ja kasvamaan urallasi sekä vaikuttamaan projektien ja oman työsi suuntaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Sinulla on kokemusta turvaluokitellusta työskentelystä tai projektikokemusta Goforen ydinalueilta, kuten digitaalisesta yhteiskunnasta (julkinen sektori, vähittäiskauppa ja palvelut, terveys, turvallisuus) tai älykkäästä teollisuudesta (kone- ja laitevalmistus, tuotantoteollisuus)
Kokemusta tekoälyavusteisuudesta ja agenttisesta ohjelmistokehityksestä
Vähintään 8 vuoden ajalta monipuolista kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä konsulttina
Vähintään 5 vuoden ajalta full-stack kokemusta joillain seuraavilla teknologioilla: Java & Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET/C#, TypeScript, React, Vue, Angular
Vähintään 3 vuoden ajalta kokemusta relaatiotietokannoista (esim. PostgreSQL tai Microsoft SQL Server)
Vähintään 3 vuoden ajalta kokemusta AWS- tai Azure-pilvialustasta ja DevOps-käytänteiden osaamista
Hyviä konsulttitaitoja ja kokemusta asiakasprojekteissa konsulttina toimimisesta eli asiakaslähtöistä asennetta sekä kykyä kommunikoida selkeästi eri alojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa
Valmiutta työskennellä asiakkaan pyytäessä asiakkaan tiloissa osana kehitystiimiä
Erinomainen suomen kielen taito konsulttityössä

Tehtävään valitulle voidaan tehdä henkilöturvallisuusselvitys, jos asiakasprojekti sitä vaatii.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Hyvinvoivat työntekijät ja sujuvan arjen luominen ovat Goforen ydin. Haluamme olla työyhteisö, jossa työn tekeminen on innostavaa, palkitsevaa ja ammatillista osaamista kasvattavaa. Maineemme laadukkaiden palveluiden tuottamisessa asiakkaillemme on yksinomaan huippuasiantuntijoidemme ansiota. Asiakastyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää ja NPS:mme onkin korkea, 62 (2025). Goforelaiset saavatkin erityisen hyvää palautetta asiakaslähtöisestä asenteesta. Työntekijätyytyväisyytemme perustuu tutkitusti osaavaan yhteisöön ja yhdessä tekemiseen.

Olemme ylpeitä läpinäkyvästä toimintakulttuuristamme, pioneerihenkisyydestämme sekä siitä että olemassaolollamme on suurempi tarkoitus kuin pelkästään voiton tuottaminen - pyrkimys inhimillisempään, kestävämpään ja eettisempään digimaailmaan ja työelämään. Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä jossa olet lähellä oman osaamisalueesi muita osaajia ja samalla läheisesti töitä tehden toisten huippuosaajien kanssa asiakasprojektissa. Olemme organisoituneet asiakaslähtöisesti, mikä mahdollistaa yksilö- ja tiimionnistumisten näkyväksi tekemisen ja oman osaamisen kasvattamisen vaikkapa toimiala edellä.

Goforelaisten yhteisöllisyys ulottuu myös työn ulkopuolelle erilaisten aktiviteettien kuten toimistotapahtumien, lautapelien ja perhepäivien muodossa. Jotta työ ja vapaa-aika löytäisivät tarvitsemasi tasapainon, tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelyolosuhteet ja työvälineet, jotka saat valita tarpeidesi mukaan.

Edellä mainittujen lisäksi meillä on kattavat etuudet. Goforella on käytössä oma, tekijöidemme näköinen työehtosopimus. Voit tutustua siihen täällä.

Palkkakehitys

Meille Goforella on tärkeää, että työstä maksetaan kunnollinen kokonaiskorvaus. Palkkaan vaikuttaa paitsi kokemus ja taidot, myös kaksi arvoamme: aktiiviset toimet sen eteen, että Gofore on hyvä työpaikka kaikille sekä asiakasnäkökulman huomioiminen kaikessa tekemisessä. Oman esihenkilön kanssa käytävissä palkkakeskusteluissa keskeistä on saamasi palaute, laskutusaste (olemmehan konsultteja!) sekä oman osaamisen kehittäminen.

Tyypillisesti palkkataso tässä roolissa asettuu välille 4500-6000 eur/kk. Kiinteän palkan lisäksi meillä on käytössä kuukausittaiseen laskutukseesi perustuvat bonukset. Määrittelemme sopivan palkkatason keskustelujen edetessä, kun tiedämme osaamisestasi tarkemmin.

Huomioimme mielellämme neurodiversiteetin vaatimukset rekrytointiprosessissa ja tarvittaessa muokkaamme prosessia tarpeidesi mukaisesti .

Jotta työ ja vapaa-aika löytäisivät tarvitsemasi tasapainon, tarjoamme sinulle joustavat työskentelyolosuhteet ja työvälineet, jotka saat valita tarpeidesi mukaan.

Edellä mainittujen lisäksi meillä on kattavat etuudet. Goforella on käytössä oma, tekijöidemme näköinen työehtosopimus. Voit tutustua siihen täällä.

Palkkakehitys

Meille Goforella on tärkeää, että työstä maksetaan kunnollinen kokonaiskorvaus. Palkkaan vaikuttaa paitsi kokemus ja taidot, myös kaksi arvoamme: aktiiviset toimet sen eteen, että Gofore on hyvä työpaikka kaikille sekä asiakasnäkökulman huomioiminen kaikessa tekemisessä. Oman esihenkilön kanssa käytävissä palkkakeskusteluissa keskeistä on saamasi palaute, laskutusaste (olemmehan konsultteja!) sekä oman osaamisen kehittäminen.

Tyypillisesti palkkataso tässä roolissa asettuu välille 4500-6000 eur/kk. Kiinteän palkan lisäksi meillä on käytössä kuukausittaiseen laskutukseesi perustuvat bonukset. Määrittelemme sopivan palkkatason keskustelujen edetessä, kun tiedämme osaamisestasi tarkemmin.

Huomioimme mielellämme neurodiversiteetin vaatimukset rekrytointiprosessissa ja tarvittaessa muokkaamme prosessia tarpeidesi mukaisesti .

Liiketoiminta ja teknologia puhuvat usein eri kieltä, ja hyvä arkkitehti osaa molempia. Nyt etsimme kokeneita arkkitehteja kahdella näkökulmalla: liiketoimintalähtöisiä ratkaisuarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita ja tekniseen järjestelmäarkkitehtuuriin erikoistuneita asiantuntijoita.

Jos tunnistat itsesi jommastakummasta, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Senior Solution Architect:
Lähdet liikkeelle asiakkaan liiketoiminnan tarpeista ja muutat tavoitteet toimiviksi, kustannustehokkaiksi ja toteutettaviksi kokonaisratkaisuiksi. Vertailet vaihtoehtoja, laadit tiekarttoja ja toimit siltana johdon, liiketoiminnan ja kehitystiimien välillä. Osaat perustella valintasi sekä kehitystiimille että johdolle. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen.

Senior Technical Architect:
Suunnittelet järjestelmiä, jotka kestävät kuormaa, muutoksia ja aikaa. Taustasi on ohjelmistokehityksessä, ja huomioit valinnoissasi skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja ylläpidettävyyden. Osaat myös tunnistaa teknisen velan ja modernisoida järjestelmiä hallitusti. Perustelet valintasi yhtä selkeästi kehitystiimille ja johdolle sekä jaat osaamistasi käytännönläheisesti. Kokemusta sinulla on vähintään 8 vuotta ja toimit projekteissa omaan asiantuntijuuteesi luottaen. 
Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

Millaista osaamista etsimme

Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ratkaisu-, kokonais- tai järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista tai ohjelmistokehityksestä
Kokemusta arkkitehtuurin suunnittelusta ja dokumentoinnista
Kokemusta liiketoimintatarpeiden ja vaatimusten muuttamisesta toimiviksi ratkaisuiksi
Ymmärrystä pilvipalveluista, integraatioista, data-arkkitehtuurista ja tietoturvasta
Kokemusta ratkaisuvaihtoehtojen ja teknologioiden arvioinnista ja vertailusta
Erinomaisia viestintä- ja sidosryhmätaitoja sekä kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa
Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen julkisen sektorin hankinnoista, legacy-järjestelmien modernisointi- ja migraatioprojekteista, JHS 179 -menetelmän ja julkisen sektorin tietoturvavaatimusten (esim. Julkri) tuntemuksen sekä arkkitehtuuriin liittyvät sertifikaatit (esim. TOGAF, Azure Solutions Architect Expert tai AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista menetelmistä ja teknologioista: TOGAF, ArchiMate, BPMN, C4-malli, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka, REST, API Management, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja menetelmiä ja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus arkkitehtuurista, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi, kumpi rooli on sinulle luontevampi, ja kerro tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi

Asiakkaan liiketoimintatavoitteiden, tarpeiden ja vaatimusten kartoittaminen
Kokonaisratkaisujen ja teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Pilvi-, integraatio- ja data-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
Teknologia- ja toimittajavalintojen arvioiminen ja perusteleminen
Tiekarttojen, arkkitehtuurikuvausten ja päätöksenteon tukimateriaalien laatiminen
Olemassa olevien järjestelmien arvioiminen ja modernisoinnin suunnitteleminen
Kehitystiimien ohjaaminen ja arkkitehtuurikatselmointien tekeminen
Yhteistyö asiakkaan johdon, liiketoiminnan, kehittäjien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

Prosessi ja palkkaus

Käymme kaikki hakemukset läpi ja vastaamme jokaiselle. Tutustumme sinuun CV:n tai LinkedIn-profiilisi kautta ja käymme myös nykyiset projektimme läpi. Mikäli projekteistamme saattaisi nyt tai lähitulevaisuudessa löytyä sinulle sopiva toimeksianto, kutsumme sinut tutustumistapaamiseen. Kun sinulle mahdollisesti sopiva asiakasprojekti löytyy, ja asiakas kiinnostuu osaamisestasi, haluaa hän useimmiten haastatella sinut kerran tai pari ennen lopullisen päätöksensä tekemistä. Mikäli asiakas haluaa sinut konsultikseen, pääsemme tekemään tarvittavat sopimukset: joko työsopimuksen tai alihankintasopimuksen, mikäli toimit mieluummin yrittäjänä.

Lisätietoa meistä

Marvel Consulting on noin 30 hengen asiantuntijatiimi, ja me kasvamme jatkuvasti! 🚀 Etsimme IT-alan osaajille mielenkiintoisia konsultointiprojekteja erilaisten asiakkaidemme parista. jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Would you like to build software at the core of algorithmic energy trading? In Algo Core, you will work on a system supporting tens of thousands of trades every day across multiple continents.

We are looking for a developer with experience building production software who wants to take responsibility, contribute to technical decisions, and learn how energy trading works in practice. You will work directly with traders and quantitative analysts, developing the software they rely on.

The team

You will join Algo Core, a team of six developers responsible for developing and maintaining the core algorithmic trading system at Norlys Energy Trading.

We share responsibility for the system’s development and reliable operation. You will take responsibility for tasks matching your experience level, with opportunities to drive work from understanding the requirements through proposing a design and implementing the solution. Designs and technical decisions are discussed with teammates, so you will have colleagues to challenge your ideas and help develop them.

The role

You will maintain and improve our existing system while developing new functionality in C#/.NET. Your work could include:
Building an integration into a new trading venue.
Developing a new trading algorithm that improves a trader’s ability to manage a position
Adding a feature to our trader-facing UI or APIs.
Investigating and fixing an issue in the core algo engine.

Part of the job is understanding what traders and quantitative analysts need and turning that into software that improves their workflows. You will also help to ensure our software and algorithms meet the technical requirements, venue rules and internal governance requirements.

The system runs around the clock, and the team shares a compensated 24/7 on-call rotation, usually one week at a time. You will join the rotation once you are ready to take on that responsibility.

In this role, you will get close to both the technology and the trading behind it. You will work directly with the traders and quants using the system, see where your work makes a difference, and build a strong understanding of algorithmic trading along the way.
– Mikkel-Alexander Vej, Manager, Algo Core

What we are looking for

We are looking for a developer with professional experience building and maintaining production software and wants to keep learning. You do not need to come in knowing the energy trading domain, but you should be interested in understanding the business behind the system you are developing.

Must-have qualifications

A master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field.
Practical experience with C#/.NET, or substantial experience in a language such as Java and the ability to transition to C#/.NET.
The ability to investigate problems, discuss technical approaches, and take responsibility for delivering solutions.
An eagerness to learn, both technically and about the domain.

Nice-to-have qualifications

Experience with real-time systems, Microsoft Azure or databases such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL and Timescale is an advantage.

Familiarity with Python, data pipelines, machine learning, statistics, or the energy sector can also provide useful background for understanding how our systems are used. These are not prerequisites for the role.

What we offer

Responsibility and influence match your experience.
Direct collaboration with traders and quantitative analysts, giving you insights into how your software affects day-to-day trading and profitability.
Opportunities to learn how algorithmic energy trading works while developing your technical skills.
Flexibility in balancing work and home life, while working primarily from our Aalborg office.
An active staff association with a range of social events.

Interested?

If you like the idea of working on software that sits close to actual trading and want to learn more about algorithmic energy markets, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer – vær med til at bygge næste generation af vores digitale platform
jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer – vær med til at bygge næste generation af vores digitale platform

Vi er i gang med at transformere vores teknologiske fundament til en modulær, kanalagnostisk arkitektur. Derfor søger vi en Platform Engineer, som vil være med til at bygge de fælles services, API’er og værktøjer, der gør det hurtigere og lettere for vores stream-aligned teams at udvikle og levere løsninger til vores CMS og apps.
Platformen er et produkt med vores udviklingsteams som brugere og din opgave er at gøre det nemt at gøre det rigtige.

Vil du gerne forandre og være noget særligt for andre? Som medarbejder i LB får du mere substans i dit job, hvor vilkår, goder og fleksibilitet gavner det hele menneske. Hos LB Forsikring lægger vi sjæl i arbejdet, og vi møder medlemmer, kolleger og omverden med skærpet sans. Du bliver en del af et medlemsejet fællesskab, hvor vi er der for hinanden. Vi deler også målet om at gøre forsikring overflødig.

Lyder de her opgaver som noget for dig?

Som Platform Engineer bliver du en del af vores nye platformteam, der både skal bygge nye tekniske byggeklodser og løbende forbedre vores måde at udvikle software på samt optimere og vedligeholde vores udviklingsplatform.

Du vil bl.a.:

Udvikle platformkomponenter som Core API, login, CI/CD og observability
Forbedre udvikleroplevelsen gennem automation, tooling og nye praksisser
Bidrage til en modulær arkitektur, hvor funktionalitet og data er tydeligt adskilt og tilgængelige via API’er
Sikre løbende vedligehold af fælles komponenter

Du får en central rolle i både modernisering af en eksisterende platform og opbygning af et fremtidssikret fundament, som skal understøtte den fortsatte udvikling af medlemsvendte digitale løsninger.

De vigtigste opgaver:

Designe og udvikle fælles platformservices og komponenter
Forbedre DevX, så teams kan levere hurtigt og sikkert fx med automation og brug af AI
Automatisere infrastruktur og deployment
Arbejde med kvalitet, test og observability
Samarbejde tæt med udviklingsteams og omsætte deres behov til konkrete løsninger
Sikre opdatering og vedligehold af udviklingsplatformen

En vigtig del af rollen er at kunne forklare og formidle tekniske valg, så andre teams kan forstå og anvende dem.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi søger en Platform Engineer med solid teknisk forståelse, lyst til at arbejde med platform og enablement og motivation til at lære sammen med andre.

Vi forestiller os, at du:
Har en solid datalogisk viden og kan arbejde effektivt med både nyudvikling og refaktorering
Har erfaring med softwareudvikling og lyst til at arbejde tættere på platform, arkitektur og udvikleroplevelse
Kan kombinere abstrakt tænkning med konkret levering
Har arbejdet med et eller flere af følgende områder: backend, API’er, integrationer, modernisering, modularisering, automation, IaC eller moderne softwareudviklingspraksis
Er nysgerrig på at forbedre udvikleroplevelsen og gøre det lettere for andre teams kommer i mål
Trives i samarbejde, deler din viden og bidrager til en kultur, hvor man trygt kan stille spørgsmål, lære og udvikle sig sammen
Kan forklare tekniske problemstillinger klart og kommunikere faglige valg, så andre kan handle på dem
Behersker dansk som arbejdssprog, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Vi er i gang med en transformation mod en headless, API-first arkitektur med fokus på modularisering og cloud-native deployment på GCP. Vi er ikke i mål endnu, så en vigtig del af rollen er at medvirke til at drive udviklingen videre.
Vi arbejder bl.a. med Headless Sitecore, React, Next.js, C#/.NET, API’er, testautomation, GitHub/Azure DevOps, Docker, Terraform og GCP. Du behøver ikke kende alle teknologier, men du har lyst til at lære de relevante dele af platformen.

Du har gerne en længerevarende teknisk uddannelse, men vi vægter relevant erfaring, god dømmekraft og læringslyst lige så højt. Vi lægger vægt på, at du møder andre med respekt, stiller gode spørgsmål og bidrager til at skabe klarhed om muligheder, løsninger og næste skridt.

Lyder rollen som noget for dig, håber vi, at du også søger, selvom du ikke matcher alle ønskerne. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, bidrage og skabe gode løsninger sammen med andre.

Hvad kan du forvente?

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor:
Vi bygger løsninger, der bruges hver dag
Vi tager ansvar for både retning og levering
Vi gør andre teams mere effektive
Vi prioriterer kvalitet, samarbejde og faglig udvikling

Vi har spurgt tre af dine kommende kolleger om, hvordan de oplever LB

”De fleste vil sige, at vores arbejde handler mere om fakta end om sanser. Det er også rigtigt i den tekniske problemløsning. Det kræver til gengæld sans for både forretningen og for andre, når der skal vælges, hvad vi løser først, og hvor langt, vi går.”

”Vi kan godt lide hinanden, vi vil gerne hinanden, og vi er der for hinanden. Sådan skal det være at gå på arbejde. LB er et fællesskab, man er en del af – både i ens eget team og med alle de andre herinde.”

”Det giver energi at kunne se formålet med det, vi laver. Det giver en substans i jobbet, når de applikationer, du arbejder på, bliver brugt af andre i den anden ende. Uanset, om det så er digital selvbetjening til medlemmerne, dokumenthåndtering til kollegerne eller noget helt tredje.”

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Hvis du synes, jobbet lyder spændende, og ønsker mere information, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingschef Jean Breinholt på tlf. 31 19 15 25.

Hvis du vil vide mere om rekrutteringsforløbet kan du kontakte HR-konsulent Sarah Sivebæk på tlf. 53 60 73 03.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!
