We are looking for students who are on their bachelors or masters that want to work on exciting projects, with fantastic colleagues and the newest technologies while providing value to our clients in the health industry.

Are you our new Associate Consultant within AI & Engineering?

We are looking for energetic, proactive, and curious Associates who want to be part of an exciting journey.

Associate Consultants at Intellishore play a vital role in our business. From the beginning, you will apply and develop your analytical, interpersonal, and development skills. You will work side by side with skilled consultants and contribute to a creative and contemporary company culture, where the skills and inputs of all employees are greatly valued.

You will get the chance to immerse yourself into some of the newest technologies whilst gaining an in-depth understanding of specific business challenges in the health industry, as you engage with clients in close collaboration with your dedicated Intellishore project team.

Our projects can be everything from actionable data and AI strategies, data architecture designs to advanced AI/ML models and scalable enterprise data platforms. Flexible and collaborative, we're not bound to any single technology or framework. You can read about some of our cases here: https://www.intellishore.dk/cases.

Our organization is structured around two tribes, Strategy & Transformation and AI & Engineering, working hand in hand on every project. We cross-staff dynamically, assembling cross-functional teams tailored to each project's needs. You'll be based in the AI & Engineering tribe.

Who is Intellishore?

Intellishore is founded in 2013, and is now home to 85+ passionate specialists in strategy, AI, and data, working from our Copenhagen and Zurich offices. We help and advise leading healthcare clients to shape the future of health, working with partners across the ecosystem to unlock the full potential of data and AI. Read more about our vision for Health 3.0 here: https://www.intellishore.dk/health.

We are builders who believe in an open and honest approach to consulting. We ask questions, stand by our beliefs, and cut through complexity to create clarity. For us, progress doesn’t come from technology alone - it happens when the right people have the right data, strategy, and tools to act. As a collective of developers and strategists, we bring energy, expertise, and a passion for helping our clients succeed.

Read more about our team here: https://www.intellishore.dk/about

What are we looking for in our new technical Associate?

We realize that you are still learning and need support, but you also need responsibilities that will push you further and develop your skills in the realm of digital transformation and healthcare.

As you will be supporting our experienced consultants on multiple cases no day is the same, but here is what you can expect and what we are looking for:

Natural flair for relation-building, stakeholder management, and communication
Work with either data science and data engineering and a wide range of technologies such as Python, Azure, GenAI, ML, LLMs etc.
Academic background in e.g. IT, engineering, or economics from CBS, ITU, DTU, KU
Part-time (Approximately 15-20 hours a week)
Preferably you have approx. two years remaining of your studies

As you develop skills and confidence, you will increase your responsibilities, and we will help you grow by tailoring a career model that urges you to apply the skills you already have and those you will gain at Intellishore.

Development is at the core of Intellishore, and we have dedicated plans for each Intellishorian and internal academy sessions for upskilling and knowledge sharing. You will also get the opportunity to influence and drive parts of the business development of Intellishore to ensure we keep getting better at delivering value to our clients.

What can we offer you?

1 | Challenging projects

Exciting and challenging consultant role in strategic and technical client projects

2 | Entrepreneurial work environment

A dynamic and entrepreneurial environment with ambitious colleagues

3 | Exciting industry

Unique opportunity to get a deep insight into the world of AI, Data & Analytics!

4 | Strategic seminars

Strategic seminars (previous years we've been to Germany, Italy, UK, Iceland and France)

5 | Flexibility

We offer a high level of flexibility in the position for you to balance your studies and work-life

6 | Amazing colleagues

Everyone talks about having a lot of social events but we don't need it, we just love spending time together!

Strategic Seminar

Every year all the Intellishorians leave behind their daily tasks to assemble for the annual Strategic Seminar to experience a change in scenery, strengthen their abilities to work together as a team, and gather inspiration to help set the overall direction of Intellishore and the work we do for our clients.

Just one more time. Why should I join Intellishore?

We are on an exciting journey to change the world of data and AI. We are entrepreneurial. We are a bit crazy. But we are also pretty cool. And nice. So, if you want to be part of an exciting journey with a bunch of crazy, but pretty cool and nice people, then don't hesitate to reach out. This is your opportunity to be part of something truly great.

Apply now

If you are interested in applying for this position, then send your application and motivational letter to us. Applicants will be invited to interviews on a rolling basis.

For more information about the position please reach out to Sofie Freund: sfr@intellishore.dk / +45 93 98 17 27

At the moment, we are only accepting applications from applicants inside of the EU who is located in Denmark.

Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale solutions across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

Experience with executive value realization, adoption measurement, ROI narratives, quarterly business reviews, and outcome-based roadmaps.
Contributions to technical communities through reusable assets, enablement, white papers, conference sessions, blogs, or mentoring.

Continuous professional development is expected to maintain currency in the Dynatrace platform and relevant industry technologies.
The role may participate in field observation, strategic customer workshops, internal enablement, and industry events.

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.

CG Tech Labs builds and supports business-critical software through experienced engineering teams. For this engagement, you will join a Microsoft business-applications team that delivers Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure solutions for multiple customers.
We are looking for a Power Platform & Azure DevOps Engineer to design, build and maintain the deployment pipelines and cloud automation behind these solutions. The goal is to standardise how Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure changes move from development through TEST and UAT to production.
This is a hands-on engineering role. It suits someone who writes and troubleshoots automation themselves, turns technical and operational requirements into reusable, secure pipelines, and can explain their decisions to consultants, developers and infrastructure specialists.

Your role with us

Build reusable Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.
Automate Azure infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code (Bicep and/or Terraform).
Help consultants and engineers onboard new customer projects onto shared, documented templates.

What you will actually do

Power Platform & Dynamics 365 ALM

Design and maintain YAML pipelines for Dynamics 365 Sales, Dataverse and Power Platform solutions.
Automate solution export, unpacking, versioning, validation, packaging and deployment with Power Platform Build Tools and the Power Platform CLI.
Promote managed solutions across TEST, UAT and PROD on a build-once, deploy-many basis.
Configure environment-specific deployment settings, including environment variables and connection references.
Add quality gates: Solution Checker, approvals, deployment checks, smoke tests and release traceability.
Support solutions containing plug-ins, custom workflow assemblies, PCF controls, Power Automate flows and model-driven apps.
Contribute to deployment automation for PPAC-managed Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations environments.

Azure DevOps & automation

Create modular YAML templates reusable across customers and projects, keeping templates, customer configuration and secrets clearly separated.
Configure repositories, branch policies, pull-request validation, artifacts, environments, approvals and service connections.
Implement secure authentication using workload identity federation or service principals.
Troubleshoot pipeline, authentication, permission and deployment failures.
Document onboarding, operational and recovery procedures.

Azure Infrastructure as Code

Design and maintain Bicep and/or Terraform, with reusable modules for common Azure resources and customer environments.
Build pipelines that validate, preview (Bicep what-if / Terraform plan) and deploy infrastructure changes.
Apply naming, tagging, security, identity and governance standards, and keep secrets out of source control.
Support controlled promotion of infrastructure changes across environments.

Azure engineering (depending on experience and project needs)

Configure App Services, Function Apps, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Storage, Application Insights and Log Analytics.
Implement managed identities and role-based access control.
Assist with monitoring, diagnostics and cost optimisation.
Investigate integration, networking, identity and deployment issues together with consultants and developers.

In your first months

Deliver a working Sales / Dataverse pipeline from source control to a non-production environment.
Turn it into reusable, documented templates with validation, approvals and security controls.
Build or improve an Azure Infrastructure as Code deployment pipeline.
Produce documentation that another engineer can operate and maintain.

What we are looking for

Hands-on experience building Azure DevOps YAML pipelines.
Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.
Practical Power Platform, Dataverse or Dynamics 365 ALM experience, including deploying solutions between environments.
Real-project experience with at least one Infrastructure as Code technology, preferably Bicep or Terraform.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, service principals, managed identities, workload identity federation and RBAC.
PowerShell or Azure CLI scripting.
Ability to troubleshoot independently using pipeline logs, platform logs and Microsoft documentation.
Strong written and spoken English, and the ability to document technical solutions clearly.

Nice to have

Power Platform Build Tools and Power Platform CLI.
Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Service.
Dataverse plug-in and PCF build processes.
PPAC-managed Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations deployments.
Azure integration services: API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Functions.
Azure Policy, Defender for Cloud, Log Analytics and Application Insights.
Automated testing for Power Platform or Azure deployments.
Experience at a Microsoft partner or across multiple customer tenants.
Relevant Microsoft certifications (for example AZ-400 or PL-400).

How you work

You prefer repeatable automation over undocumented manual steps.
You treat identities, permissions and secrets as part of the design.
You know a successful deployment is not necessarily a successful release.
You balance standardisation with legitimate customer-specific requirements.
You challenge unclear requirements and propose a practical first version.
You own the work from design through testing, documentation and handover.

What you get

A hands-on role shaping how Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure solutions are delivered across multiple customers.
Ownership of reusable pipeline and Infrastructure as Code standards that other teams will adopt.
Breadth across Power Platform ALM, Azure DevOps and Azure engineering.
Direct collaboration with consultants, developers and infrastructure specialists.
Competitive compensation.

Voor onze partner in regio Mechelen zijn we op zoek naar een Senior Agentic Software Engineer die een verschil wil maken. Je komt terecht in een innovatieve R&D-omgeving waar softwareontwikkeling en artificiële intelligentie steeds meer hand in hand gaan.

Samen met een multidisciplinair Scrum-team ontwikkel je moderne cloud-native applicaties op het Microsoft-platform. Je bouwt niet alleen kwalitatieve software, maar speelt ook een actieve rol in de transformatie naar AI-assisted en agentic softwareontwikkeling.

Waar softwareontwikkeling vroeger voornamelijk draaide om het handmatig schrijven van code, werk je vandaag steeds vaker samen met AI-systemen. Je gebruikt AI-tools en software agents om analyses uit te voeren, code te genereren, testen op te zetten, documentatie te creëren en repetitieve engineeringtaken te automatiseren.

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare softwareoplossingen op basis van .NET en Azure.
Actief inzetten van AI-tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Claude Code en vergelijkbare oplossingen als onderdeel van je dagelijkse workflow.
Complexe businessvraagstukken vertalen naar opdrachten die efficiënt door AI-systemen kunnen worden uitgevoerd.
Reviewen, valideren en verbeteren van AI-gegenereerde code, documentatie en analyses.
Ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Samenwerken met architecten, product owners en business analisten om kwalitatieve softwareoplossingen te realiseren.
Bijdragen aan technische standaarden, softwarekwaliteit en de verdere professionalisering van AI-gedreven development.
Ondersteunen van collega's bij het adopteren van AI-tools en nieuwe manieren van softwareontwikkeling.

Profiel

Je behaalde een bachelor- of masterdiploma in een relevante richting (Toegepaste Informatica, Software Engineering, Computer Science...).

C#
.NET 10 (of eerdere moderne .NET-versies)
ASP.NET Core
RESTful API's
CQRS
Domain Driven Design (DDD)
React

Je denkt in architectuur, schaalbaarheid en lange termijn onderhoudbaarheid.

Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid belangrijker zijn dan louter snelheid.

At Jan De Nul Group
, you will join an international and technically innovative environment where digitalization and data play an increasingly important role in offshore, dredging, and infrastructure projects. From our headquarters in Hofstade-Aalst

that enables different teams to efficiently develop and manage applications, dashboards, and automations.

Within our ICT department, you will play a key role in the development and support of the Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Microsoft Fabric, etc.). You will work closely with the business and support teams in building structured, secure, and scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities include:

supporting and advising the business on the use of the Power Platform;
helping define best practices, governance, and architectural guidelines;
setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Git) for Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate;
defining and maintaining deployment strategies across multiple environments (dev, test, prod);
implementing version control, backup, and lifecycle management;
establishing standards around naming conventions, policies, monitoring, and auditing;
integrating security and access management with existing IAM solutions;
ensuring secure and efficient data integration;
monitoring platform usage, performance, and adoption;
acting as a link between business, development, and infrastructure teams.

What do you need?

We are looking for a medior to senior profile with strong knowledge of the Microsoft Power Platform and a clear vision on how such platforms should be structured and managed within an organization.

You have experience with tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate and are comfortable working in Azure environments, preferably including Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and version control with Git. Knowledge of deployment strategies, lifecycle management, and governance is important for this role.

In addition, you have a good understanding of security, identity & access management, and data governance to ensure that solutions remain secure, stable, and manageable in the long term. Experience with Microsoft Fabric is considered a strong plus.

Beyond technical expertise, we are looking for someone who can work independently, takes ownership, and communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You work in a structured way, pay attention to detail, and proactively contribute ideas for improvements and standards.

Working at Jan De Nul means helping to find solutions to some of the greatest challenges of our time: from the energy transition and rising sea levels to smart mobility. You become part of an internationally growing family business.

Jan De Nul shapes water and land worldwide. We drive the transition to renewable energy with offshore energy infrastructure. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Power Platform & Copilot Studio Engineer (w/m/x)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Als Senior Power Platform Engineer bei Avanade gestalten Sie die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden – von DAX-Konzernen bis hin zu globalen Marktführern. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Lösungen auf Basis der Microsoft Power Platform und arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld mit den klügsten Köpfen rund um den Microsoft Stack.

Bei Avanade erwartet Sie ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Kreativität, Innovation und persönliche Weiterentwicklung gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Together we do what matters.

In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie End-to-End-Lösungen über die gesamte Breite der Power Platform: von intelligenten Agenten in Copilot Studio über automatisierte Geschäftsprozesse mit Power Automate bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Apps mit Canvas und Model-driven Apps. Sie sind technische Sparringspartnerin oder technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und treiben den Einsatz von Automation und KI im Microsoft-Ökosystem voran.

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption und Umsetzung von End-to-End-Lösungen auf der gesamten Power Platform inklusive Agentic AI mit Copilot Studio
Entwicklung von Multi-Agent-Lösungen, Copilot Studio Agents (vormals Power Virtual Agents), Canvas Apps, Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows, Dataverse-Artefakten, AI Builder, Business Process Flows und Model-driven Apps
Architekturentscheidungen und technische Führung in komplexen Enterprise-Projekten
Aufbau und Erweiterung der Power Platform Capabilities bei unseren Kunden
Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen und Effizienzsteigerungen in bestehenden Geschäftsprozessen
Integration der Power Platform mit Microsoft 365, Azure und Drittsystemen
Etablierung von Best Practices, Governance-Modellen, Center of Excellence und ALM-Prozessen
Mentoring und Wissenstransfer im Team sowie bei den Kunden
Kontinuierliches Monitoring neuer Features im Microsoft-Stack und Bewertung für den Kundeneinsatz

Qualifications

Qualifikation und Erfahrung

Power Platform Expertise

Mehrjährige tiefgehende Erfahrung mit der gesamten Power Platform Suite
Expertise in Copilot Studio / Power Virtual Agents inklusive Multi-Agent-Architekturen
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power Automate Cloud Flows und Desktop Flows (RPA), inklusive Computer Use
Expertise in der Entwicklung von Canvas Apps und Model-driven Apps
Fundierte Erfahrung mit Dataverse: Datenmodellierung, Security, Plug-ins, Business Rules
Erfahrung mit AI Builder und Business Process Flows
ALM für Power Platform: Solutions, Pipelines, Power Platform CLI, Azure DevOps oder GitHub

KI & moderne Architekturen (nice to have)

Kenntnisse in Azure AI Foundry und Microsoft 365 SDK
Erfahrung mit der Anbindung und Auswahl von Large Language Models (LLM)
Kenntnisse von Model Context Protocol (MCP) und Agent-to-Agent-Kommunikation von Vorteil
Verständnis für Prompt Engineering und Grounding-Strategien

Microsoft Stack

Solides Verständnis von Microsoft 365 inklusive M365 Copilot, Teams und SharePoint
Erfahrung mit Azure Services (Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Storage)
Datenformate XML und JSON sicher im Einsatz
Kenntnisse in Azure AI Foundry und Microsoft 365 SDK, Kenntnisse von Model Context Protocol (MCP) und Agent-to-Agent-Kommunikation von Vorteil

Softwareentwicklung

Erfahrung in mindestens einer der folgenden Technologien: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, .NET (C#, ASP.NET), PowerShell
Erfahrung mit REST APIs und Custom Connectors
Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

Was dich auszeichnet

Erfahrung in der Beratung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Enterprise-Projekte
Souveräne Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern auf Fach- und Management-Ebene
Erfahrung im Anforderungsmanagement - Aufnahme, Analyse und Dokumentation
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Starte beruflich durch

Einige Der Vorteile Wenn Du Bei Avanade Arbeitest

Die Möglichkeit, für Microsoft Global Alliance Partner des Jahres zu arbeiten (14 Jahre in Folge), mit außergewöhnlichen Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Schulung (mindestens 80 Stunden pro Jahr für Schulungen und bezahlte Zertifizierungen)  
Zusammenarbeit mit technisch versierten und qualifizierten Kolleg:innen weltweit.   
Ein engagierter Career Adviser, der dich bei deinem Karrierewachstum unterstützt.  
Motivierte und hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich an dir interessiert sind. 
Wir legen großen Wert auf leistungsorientierte sowie wettbewerbsfähige Entlohnung und bieten dir je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, das deutlich über dem IT-KV Mindestgehalt liegt. (Das derzeitge IT-KV-Mindestgehalt (2025) beträgt  €43.078 - €71.848 (Vollzeitbasis) abhängig von der Einstufung)

Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier
.

Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten

Über 60.000 Professionals, 26 Länder und ein Universum – das ist Avanade. Egal welche digitale Fragestellung, im Microsoft-Ökosystem finden wir die Lösung. Denn: Wir sind nicht von schlechten Eltern. Accenture LLP und die Microsoft Corporation haben uns 2000 in die Welt gesetzt. Logisch, dass wir das Beste aus beiden Welten gekonnt verbinden.

Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben.

Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kultur investieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Du möchtest Geschäftsprozesse neu denken und Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, das Potenzial von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform erfolgreich zu nutzen?

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Über die Rolle

Als Senior Power Platform Engineer bei Avanade gestalten Sie die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden – von DAX-Konzernen bis hin zu globalen Marktführern. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Lösungen auf Basis der Microsoft Power Platform und arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld mit den klügsten Köpfen rund um den Microsoft Stack.

Bei Avanade erwartet Sie ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Kreativität, Innovation und persönliche Weiterentwicklung gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Together we do what matters.

In dieser spezialisierten Rolle übernehmen Sie die technische Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Power Pages Projekte – von der Architektur über die Entwicklung externer Portale bis hin zur Integration in die gesamte Power Platform und das Microsoft-Ökosystem. Sie sind unser Experte und unsere Expertin, wenn es darum geht, leistungsstarke, sichere und nutzerfreundliche Self-Service-Portale für unsere Kunden zu realisieren.

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption und Umsetzung komplexer Power Pages Lösungen für externe Nutzergruppen (B2B, B2C, Partner-Portale, Self-Service-Portale)
Design der Informationsarchitektur, des Berechtigungskonzepts (Web Roles, Table Permissions) und der Authentifizierung (Azure AD B2C, externe Identity Provider)
Entwicklung und Anpassung von Liquid-Templates, Web Templates, Page Templates und Content Snippets
Erweiterung von Power Pages durch eigenes JavaScript, HTML und CSS sowie durch Integration externer APIs
Anbindung von Power Pages an Dataverse, Power Automate, Azure Services und Drittsysteme
Implementierung von responsiven, barrierefreien Designs unter Berücksichtigung von Performance und SEO
Sicherstellung von Sicherheit, Datenschutz (DSGVO) und Compliance in öffentlich zugänglichen Portalen
Aufbau und Etablierung von Best Practices, ALM-Prozessen (Azure DevOps, GitHub) und Deployment-Pipelines für Power Pages
Mentoring und Coaching von Junior- und Mid-Level-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen
Beratung der Kunden zu Portal-Strategien, User Experience und Skalierungsthemen

Qualifications

Qualifikation und Erfahrung

Power Pages Expertise

Mehrjährige tiefgehende Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Power Pages / Power Apps Portals (vormals Dynamics 365 Portals / ADX Studio)
Fundiertes Wissen in Liquid-Template-Sprache, Web Templates und Page Templates
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+) sowie idealerweise TypeScript
Erfahrung mit Bootstrap und Frontend-Frameworks im Power Pages Kontext
Tiefes Verständnis von Power Pages Sicherheitskonzepten: Web Roles, Table Permissions, Site Settings
Erfahrung mit Authentifizierungsmechanismen: Azure AD B2C, OAuth 2.0, SAML, Custom Identity Provider
Power Pages Management App, Portal Management und Configuration Migration Tool
ALM für Power Pages: Solutions, Deployment Profiles, Power Platform CLI

Power Platform & Microsoft Stack

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Dataverse: Datenmodellierung, Business Rules, Plug-ins, Security Roles
Erfahrung mit Power Automate (Cloud Flows) zur Prozessautomatisierung rund um Portal-Szenarien
Grundkenntnisse in Canvas Apps und Model-driven Apps für ergänzende interne Lösungen
Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, Teams) und Azure Services (Functions, Logic Apps, Storage, API Management)

Softwareentwicklung

Fundierte Erfahrung in JavaScript / TypeScript, idealerweise React
Erfahrung mit REST APIs und Web Services (JSON, XML)
Kenntnisse in C# / .NET für Plug-in-Entwicklung und Custom Connectors von Vorteil
Git, Azure DevOps oder GitHub für Versionskontrolle und CI/CD

Was dich auszeichnet

Souveräne Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern auf Fach- und Management-Ebene
Erfahrung im Anforderungsmanagement - Aufnahme, Analyse und Dokumentation
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Starte beruflich durch

Einige Der Vorteile Wenn Du Bei Avanade Arbeitest

Die Möglichkeit, für Microsoft Global Alliance Partner des Jahres zu arbeiten (14 Jahre in Folge), mit außergewöhnlichen Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Schulung (mindestens 80 Stunden pro Jahr für Schulungen und bezahlte Zertifizierungen)  
Zusammenarbeit mit technisch versierten und qualifizierten Kolleg:innen weltweit.   
Ein engagierter Career Adviser, der dich bei deinem Karrierewachstum unterstützt.  
Motivierte und hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich an dir interessiert sind. 
Wir legen großen Wert auf leistungsorientierte sowie wettbewerbsfähige Entlohnung und bieten dir je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation ein attraktives Vergütungspaket, das deutlich über dem IT-KV Mindestgehalt liegt. (Das derzeitge IT-KV-Mindestgehalt (2025) beträgt  €43.078 - €71.848 (Vollzeitbasis) abhängig von der Einstufung)

Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier
.

Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten

Über 60.000 Professionals, 26 Länder und ein Universum – das ist Avanade. Egal welche digitale Fragestellung, im Microsoft-Ökosystem finden wir die Lösung. Denn: Wir sind nicht von schlechten Eltern. Accenture LLP und die Microsoft Corporation haben uns 2000 in die Welt gesetzt. Logisch, dass wir das Beste aus beiden Welten gekonnt verbinden.

Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben.

Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kultur investieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Der perfekte Start in einem Unternehmen, das gegründet wurde, um geschäftskritische, führende Technologielösungen zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten, interagieren und leben verbessern möchte.

Do What Matters

Wir glauben daran, dass inklusive und diverse Teams jede Challenge meistern – wer sich Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und Mut stellt, ist bei uns genau richtig. Deine Bewerbung ist willkommen - unabhängig deiner Herkunft, Nationalität, Glaube, Behinderung, Alter, Familienstand, Partnerschaftsstatus, sexueller Orientierung und deines Geschlechts. Bei uns darfst du einfach du sein. Vielfalt in jeder Form ist uns eine echte Herzensangelegenheit und ein fester Bestandteil der Avanade-Kultur.

Das klingt nach einen Ort an dem du arbeiten möchtest? Dann schau dir unsere weiterführenden Informationen an:

Sustainable, AI & Cloud Business Services | Avanade

Avanade Insights Blog | Avanade

Insights: Future, reimagined | Avanade

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for designing, developing and testing software modules, ensuring optimal functionality and integration within complex systems. The role demands a combination of in-depth technical expertise and collaboration with cross-functional teams to innovate and deliver high-quality software solutions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

We are looking for an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to join our engineering team and help design, build, and maintain scalable business-critical applications. You will work closely with product owners, architects, and fellow engineers in an agile environment, contributing across the full software development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate combines strong backend expertise in .NET with modern frontend development experience in Angular, possesses excellent SQL skills, and has a solid understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable applications using .NET and Angular.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
Build and optimize database solutions, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.
Support CI/CD processes and contribute to DevOps best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues while ensuring application stability and performance.
Conduct code review.
Continuously improve software quality through testing, automation, and engineering best practices.

YOUR PROFILE

5+ years of professional experience in software development.
Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core / .NET technologies and C#.
Solid experience with Angular and modern frontend development practices.
Strong knowledge of SQL databases, including database design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning.
Good understanding of software architecture principles and application design.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented programming, design patterns, and data structures.
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
Experience working with Git and modern CI/CD pipelines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Fluent in English.

NICE TO HAVE

Experience with NoSQL technologies such as Elasticsearch.
Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with monitoring and observability tools.
Knowledge of microservices architecture and distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum/SAFe environments.
Experience with message brokers and event-driven architectures.
Experience with React.

Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What We Value

Ownership and accountability
Strong engineering mindset and attention to quality.
Curiosity and continuous learning.
Ability to balance technical excellence with business needs.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to share knowledge and mentor others.

jobs.description:
Apply now »

Festo inspires people and organizations around the world with innovative solutions for industrial automation. We are an independent family business and offer more than 20,000 employees the opportunity to take bold steps, realize their ideas, and take on responsibility. As a team, we grow by tackling challenges together and we welcome everyone who wants to move the world with us.

Senior Backend Developer

15204

Barcelona

Full Time

Information Technology

Festo Automation S.A.U.

Role Description

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join our IT Digital Marketing team within the Digital Sales Hub in Barcelona. In this role, you will design, build, and continuously improve backend services, APIs, databases, and integrations that support our digital marketing and sales capabilities.

You will develop scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-hosted solutions that enable data flows and business processes across platforms such as Web Content Management, Digital Asset Management, Marketing Automation, Consent Management, and Web Analytics.

As a senior member of an international Agile team, you will take technical ownership of selected backend solutions, contribute to architecture and engineering standards, and collaborate with frontend engineers, product owners, platform teams, and business stakeholders across different countries and functions.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain backend services, REST APIs, message-driven services, search capabilities, and database schemas supporting customer-facing digital products.
Develop business logic, domain services, and data-access layers using C# and .NET, with a focus on scalability, security, observability, and fault tolerance.
Design and implement integrations with external platforms and services, including WCMS, DAM, Marketing Automation, Consent Management, and Web Analytics solutions.
Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, deployment processes, and quality gates.
Apply and promote engineering practices such as automated testing, code reviews, versioning, continuous integration, monitoring and logging.
Participate actively in Agile team activities and contribute to planning, estimation, and reliable iterative delivery.
Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, including architecture decisions, API specifications, integration designs, and operational runbooks.
Analyse and resolve second-level support cases, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions to prevent recurring issues.

Requirements

Must-have:

Professional experience in backend or software engineering with exposure to frontend integration, ideally in a digital marketing, digital sales, e-commerce, or customer-facing platform environment.
Strong, hands-on programming experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem.
Experience designing and building APIs (RESTful services) and working with relational databases.
Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and reliable software-delivery processes.
Practical experience applying Test-Driven Development (TDD) and maintaining high-quality, well-tested codebases.
Agile mindset and practical experience working in Scrum teams.
Ability to communicate technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders in an international environment.
Very good written and spoken English.

Nice-to-have

You do not need to meet all of the following criteria. We would be interested in any combination of experience in:

Cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS and cloud-native services.
Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
API management, API gateways, authentication, rate limiting, and API lifecycle management.
Content Delivery Networks (CDNs).
Monitoring, logging, alerting, tracing, and observability platforms.
Message-driven architectures, distributed systems, and data-integration patterns.
Web Content Management, Digital Asset Management, Marketing Automation, or e-commerce platforms.
Razor, Blazor, or supporting frontend integration within .NET-based applications.
Additional programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript

Your Global Benefits At a Glance

Diverse opportunities for your development

A strong team by your side

Freedom to drive your ideas forward

Develop innovative solutions with real impact

Be part of a global network – in a family-owned company

Attractive Compensation And Additional Benefits

We look forward to your application and to getting to know you!

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Green Eagle Solutions is a leader in automating renewable energy operations, empowering energy producers to optimize their assets and trading strategies with innovative SaaS solutions. Our flagship platform, ARSOS, integrates advanced automation to enhance operational efficiency and trading performance, ensuring renewable energy producers can maximize revenue in dynamic energy markets. Join us in driving the energy transition and shaping the future of energy trading through cutting-edge automation.

Joining Green Eagle means growing alongside the company and becoming part of the transformative mindset that defines us. 🚀

If you are encouraged to do great things, join our team! 🤝💚

The challenge:

Green Eagle builds mission-critical energy optimisation systems. Our platform processes real-time telemetry from renewable assets and integrates with control centres and grid operators through industrial protocols. When it degrades, energy production is affected directly. Reliability and delivery speed are not preferences here; they are constraints we design for.
As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will build and evolve our Internal Developer Platform: the foundation that lets engineering teams ship safely, quickly and autonomously. You will design the systems, workflows and abstractions that reduce cognitive load and make reliability, security and scalability the default rather than something each team solves again on its own.
The Platform team operates as a product team, and internal engineers are your customers. Your first months will go into understanding the current infrastructure, the delivery pipelines and where teams work around the platform instead of through it. From there, your impact will come from adoption and from measurable outcomes for the teams you serve, not from the sophistication of what you build.

Our Environment:

We value proactivity and ownership, systems thinking, automation over manual work, and simple reusable solutions over unnecessary complexity. We expect engineering outcomes to be measured rather than asserted.
Our stack:
.NET services and Angular applications
AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps (ArgoCD)
GitHub Enterprise and GitHub Actions
PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, Redis and Kafka
OpenTelemetry-aligned observability and Datadog
Internal tooling and developer platform capabilities

You do not need to be an expert in all of it from day one, but you should be comfortable across infrastructure, delivery systems, developer tooling and production environments.

What You`ll Be Doing:

Internal Developer Platform.
Design and build the platform that lets teams create, deploy and operate services with minimal friction. Define and implement golden paths for service creation, CI/CD, observability and infrastructure provisioning. Standardise GitHub workflows, reusable actions, and deployment pipelines.
Self-service infrastructure.
Build self-service infrastructure modules on Terraform and GitOps principles. Create ephemeral environments and local development tooling that cut onboarding time and testing friction.
Reliability, performance, security, and cost by default
. Embed observability, security and compliance into the platform, so teams inherit them rather than implement them. Work with product teams to identify and remove infrastructure and platform bottlenecks that impact product performance, scalability, and reliability. Align standards around SLOs, monitoring and capacity planning, and work with Finance to improve infrastructure cost visibility and efficiency.
AI-assisted engineering enablement.
Turn AI practices into reusable platform capabilities: integrate AI tooling into golden paths and developer workflows and build the guardrails and validation mechanisms that let teams gain speed without losing quality.
Platform as a product.
Own the platform roadmap. Drive adoption of platform capabilities and measure usage, satisfaction, and impact. Improve DORA metrics through systemic platform changes, and contribute to the evolution of modular, scalable systems.
Technical influence.
Lead technical discussions on delivery and infrastructure across teams, review designs, and raise the level of the engineers who build on the platform. Influence through the quality of the paved roads you provide, not through gates.

What You need to Succeed:

Solid experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering at senior level, with strong programming skills (Python, Go or similar).
Strong experience designing CI/CD systems at scale, ideally GitHub Actions, and a deep understanding of Kubernetes and containerised environments.
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and GitOps workflows
A track record of reducing developer friction, with a solid grasp of observability patterns and production readiness.
Experience integrating AI tools into engineering workflows with rigour: clear specs, validated outputs and the same quality bar as manual work.
Ability to influence architecture and delivery decisions across teams, with strong communication and ownership mindset.

Why Work At Green Eagle?

💰 Compensation: €65,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on your experience and overall fit for the role.
📈 Real ownership of the platform roadmap, with internal engineers as your customers.
🏆 Certified Great Place to Work® by our own team.
🌍 Join a purpose-driven company transforming renewable energy operations through technology.
🖥 Hybrid work model, combining remote work with our offices in Madrid or Seville.
🏡 Flexible working hours.
💰 Flexible compensation package (childcare, transportation, and meals).
🏥 Private health insurance.
🌱 Annual learning and sports activity allowance.
👌 Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of brands and services.

Ensure solutions are fit for purpose, scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
Support integration with existing systems and processes, minimizing disruption and technical debt.
Participate in design reviews, providing constructive feedback and guidance.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Act as a trusted advisor to delivery teams, helping navigate technical challenges and dependencies.
Liaise with vendors to ensure solutions meet compliance and interoperability standards.

Governance & Quality Assurance

Document solution designs clearly for technical and non-technical audiences.
Support risk identification and mitigation during solution delivery.

Strong understanding of application design, integration patterns, and cloud technologies.

Je werkt aan robuuste back-end-oplossingen en bouwt dynamische, gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces met Angular of React. Je werkt nauw samen met collega-ontwikkelaars, testers en stakeholders om schaalbare en efficiënte applicaties te ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren. Bij Respellion combineren we innovatie, flexibiliteit en samenwerking om toonaangevende technologische oplossingen te creëren. Als jonge, snelgroeiende organisatie werken we zonder hiërarchie en heeft iedereen de vrijheid om zelfstandig bij te dragen. We maken gebruik van open-source technologieën om duurzame en schaalbare applicaties te ontwikkelen die bedrijven helpen om efficiënter te werken. We werken met specialistisch talent en werken nauw samen met onze klanten om op maat gemaakte oplossingen te leveren. In ons eerste jaar hebben we al enorme vooruitgang geboekt, en we blijven ambitieuze stappen zetten. Klaar om samen met ons te groeien en echte impact te maken?

Hoe zien we jouw rol?

Als Full-stack .NET ontwikkelaar werk je aan uiteenlopende softwareprojecten bij onze klanten én draag je bij aan de groei van onze eigen organisatie. Afhankelijk van de opdracht ben je betrokken bij het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van softwareoplossingen. Dit kan variëren van front-end tot back-end ontwikkeling, het bouwen van API’s of het verbeteren van bestaande applicaties.

Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire teams en denkt mee over architectuur, performance en security. Je draagt bij aan een efficiënte ontwikkelomgeving en helpt bij het implementeren van best practices en moderne technologieën. Afhankelijk van de opdracht kun je werken aan onderwerpen zoals cloudoplossingen, CI/CD-pipelines of software-integraties.

Je bouwt een generieke servicelaag die op basis van modellen runtime complete applicaties uitvoert

Je zorgt dat features één keer gebouwd worden en overal werken
Je werkt aan core platform capabilities zoals workflows, integraties, security, AI functionaliteit of API-functionaliteit
Je optimaliseert de servicelaag voor schaal, performance en consistent gedrag over alle klanten
Je gebruikt Ai in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld bij het schrijven van code en het optimaliseren van bestaande code

Je neemt beslissingen die direct impact hebben op alle applicaties die met het platform gebouwd zijn

Je accepteert niet dat iets “specifiek voor één case” is

Als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, een belangrijke inkomensverzekeraar in het zuiden van Nederland, werk je aan de vernieuwing van een belangrijk digitaal platform voor klanten en collega's. Je speelt een centrale rol in de migratie van de bestaande Sitecore-omgeving naar een moderne headless ContentStack-omgeving en helpt mee om het platform klaar te maken voor de toekomst. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op front-endontwikkeling met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript, terwijl je ook betrokken bent bij API's en de verdere modernisering van de back-end. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, testers, een businessanalist en de product owner aan oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Bovendien krijg je ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen richting back-enddevelopment en mee te denken over de technische koers van het platform. Wil jij bouwen aan een nieuw digitaal platform binnen een betrokken team dat volop in ontwikkeling is? Solliciteer dan nu als Fullstack Developer bij Loyalis, onderdeel van a.s.r.!

je ontwikkelt en verbetert de front-end van het nieuwe digitale platform met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript

je vertaalt ontwerpen naar toegankelijke, schaalbare en onderhoudsvriendelijke front-endoplossingen
je koppelt front-endcomponenten aan API's en ContentStack

je werkt mee aan de migratie van technisch complexe functionaliteit naar nieuwe API's en services

je draagt bij aan het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van API's in .NET, inclusief documentatie via Swagger

een bruto salaris van € 4.100 - € 5.800 op basis van 38 uur per week, een 13e maand en 8% vakantievergoeding. Een thuiswerkvergoeding en korting op verzekeringen

een NS-Business Card met vrij reizen (ook privé) of een kilometervergoeding
veel aandacht voor je ontwikkeling, je inzetbaarheid en je gezondheid
hybride werken: gemiddeld 60% vanuit huis en 40% op kantoor en veel ruimte om je eigen werktijden te bepalen
werk waarmee je een positieve invloed hebt op de samenleving van morgen; samen stropen we onze mouwen op voor een eerlijkere en duurzamere toekomst

Deze vacature is echt iets voor jou, want jij
hebt ervaring met Vue.js, Nuxt en TypeScript of vergelijkbare moderne front-end frameworks
hebt ervaring met contentmanagementsystemen; ervaring met een migratietraject is een pré (bijvoorbeeld Sitecore of een headless CMS zoals ContentStack)

hebt affiniteit met back-endontwikkeling en API-integraties

communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en werkt graag samen binnen een scrumteam

Je gaat aan de slag in Team Apollo binnen Loyalis. Wij zijn "responsible rebels" die geloven in de kracht van een organisatie waarin vertrouwen centraal staat. Als Software Tester ben je een essentiële schakel in het ontwikkelproces en zorg je ervoor dat software betrouwbaar en robuust wordt opgeleverd. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, beheerders en stakeholders om teststrategieën te definiëren, geautomatiseerde tests op te zetten en het testproces continu te verbeteren. Je hebt een sterke focus op testautomatisering, API- en UI-testing en draagt bij aan een efficiënte CI/CD-pipeline.

Maak kennis met Respellion

Bij Respellion combineren we innovatie, flexibiliteit en samenwerking om toonaangevende technologische oplossingen te creëren. Als jonge, snelgroeiende organisatie werken we zonder hiërarchie en heeft iedereen de vrijheid om zelfstandig bij te dragen. We maken gebruik van open-source technologieën om duurzame en schaalbare applicaties te ontwikkelen die bedrijven helpen om efficiënter te werken.

We werken met specialistisch talent en werken nauw samen met onze klanten om op maat gemaakte oplossingen te leveren. In ons eerste jaar hebben we al enorme vooruitgang geboekt, en we blijven ambitieuze stappen zetten. Klaar om samen met ons te groeien en echte impact te maken?

Hoe zien we jouw rol?

Als Software Tester ben jij de schakel tussen ontwikkeling en kwaliteitsborging. Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire teams en zorgt ervoor dat software betrouwbaar en efficiënt getest wordt voordat deze in productie gaat. Dit betekent dat je je bezighoudt met het opzetten, onderhouden en verbeteren van geautomatiseerde tests op verschillende niveaus, waaronder API-, UI- en performancetests.

Naast het automatiseren van tests, adviseer je ontwikkelteams over teststrategie en testbaarheid. Je helpt met het identificeren van risico’s, het structureren van testscenario’s en het implementeren van testautomatisering binnen een CI/CD-pipeline. Je hebt ervaring met verschillende testframeworks en weet hoe je testprocessen efficiënter en effectiever kunt maken.

Het inzichtelijk maken van testresultaten en het voortdurend optimaliseren van teststrategieën spelen een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van softwarekwaliteit. Je weet de onderliggende risico’s in softwarekwaliteit te achterhalen – eerst analyseren, dan automatiseren. Vervolgens werk je testscenario’s uit in concrete geautomatiseerde tests die direct bijdragen aan de kwaliteit van softwareontwikkeling.

Daarnaast heb je sterke vaardigheden in samenwerking en kennisdeling, waardoor je teams helpt om testprocessen continu te verbeteren. Je hebt niet alleen oog voor techniek, maar ook voor de menselijke factor binnen softwarekwaliteit.

Je rol binnen Respellion

Standort: Tübingen | Hybrid

Über uns

Wir sind relyon
, ein wachsender Systemintegrator für moderne IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerke, Cloud, Automatisierung und KI.

Wir unterstützen mittelständische Unternehmen und Großkunden dabei, ihre IT sicher, leistungsfähig und zukunftsfähig aufzustellen. Dabei verbinden wir klassische IT-Infrastruktur mit modernen Cloud-, Automatisierungs- und AI-Technologien.

Intelligent Systems. Reliable Impact.

Deine Rolle

Wir suchen keinen System Engineer, der seit zehn Jahren immer dieselben Systeme administriert.

Wir suchen einen technisch starken Generalisten und High Potential
, der eine solide IT-Basis mitbringt, sich schnell in neue Technologien einarbeitet und KI selbstverständlich als Werkzeug nutzt
, um schneller zu lernen, Probleme zu analysieren, Lösungen zu entwickeln und wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren.

Du musst deshalb noch nicht jedes Produkt aus unserem Tech Stack bis ins letzte Detail kennen.

Wichtiger ist uns, dass du IT-Infrastrukturen verstehst, technische Zusammenhänge schnell erkennst und dich auch an Themen herantraust, mit denen du bisher noch nicht gearbeitet hast.

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht nur mit bestehenden Systemen. Du sollst aktiv mitgestalten, wie ein moderner System Engineer mit AI, Automation und intelligenten Tools arbeitet.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet

Du arbeitest generalistisch über verschiedene Bereiche moderner IT-Infrastruktur hinweg und entwickelst dich abhängig von deinen Stärken zunehmend zum technischen Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören unter anderem:

Planung, Implementierung und Betrieb moderner IT-Infrastrukturen und hybrider Umgebungen

Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Microsoft 365
, Entra ID
, Intune
und Microsoft-basierten Kundenumgebungen

Arbeit mit Azure und hybriden Azure-/On-Premises-Infrastrukturen

Konfiguration und Troubleshooting von Netzwerken, Firewalls, VPNs, VLANs und weiteren Netzwerkkomponenten

Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Sophos Firewall- und Security-Lösungen

Monitoring und Management von Client- und Serverumgebungen mit NinjaOne

Analyse und strukturierte Lösung technischer Störungen im 2nd- und 3rd-Level-Umfeld

Automatisierung wiederkehrender administrativer Prozesse, beispielsweise mit n8n, PowerShell, APIs oder AI-gestützten Workflows

Nutzung von Generative AI und Large Language Models (LLMs)
bei Troubleshooting, Recherche, Dokumentation, Scripting und Automatisierung

Entwicklung neuer Ansätze, wie wir AI und Automation im IT-Betrieb
sinnvoll einsetzen können

Technische Dokumentation und Weitergabe deines Wissens innerhalb des Teams

Mitarbeit an Kundenprojekten rund um Cloud, Netzwerk, Security, Modern Workplace und Managed Services

Unser Tech Stack

Abhängig vom jeweiligen Kunden und Projekt arbeitest du unter anderem mit:

Microsoft & Cloud

Microsoft 365

Microsoft Entra ID

Microsoft Intune

Microsoft Azure

Azure Local / hybride Infrastrukturen

Windows Server

Active Directory

PowerShell

Network & Security

Sophos Firewall

Netzwerkarchitekturen

VPN

VLAN

DNS / DHCP

Routing & Switching

Automation & Operations

n8n

NinjaOne

APIs

PowerShell

Monitoring- und RMM-Lösungen

AI

Generative AI

Large Language Models

AI-Assisted Troubleshooting

AI-gestützte Recherche und Dokumentation

AI Automation und intelligente Workflows

Wir erwarten ausdrücklich nicht
, dass du bereits in allen genannten Technologien Experte bist.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest

Deine technische Basis

Du hast eine solide Grundlage in der IT-Infrastruktur und verstehst, was hinter den Systemen passiert.

Idealerweise bringst du Kenntnisse in mehreren der folgenden Bereiche mit:

Microsoft 365 oder vergleichbaren Cloud-Umgebungen

Windows Server und Active Directory

Microsoft Azure oder hybriden Cloud-Infrastrukturen

Netzwerkgrundlagen wie TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN, VPN und Routing

Firewalls und IT-Security

Client-, Server- oder Endpoint-Management

Scripting oder Automatisierung, beispielsweise mit PowerShell, Python oder Low-Code-/No-Code-Tools

Eine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration
, ein Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation ist hilfreich.

Entscheidender als dein Abschluss ist für uns aber, was du technisch verstehst und wie schnell du Neues lernen kannst.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

Du arbeitest AI-first

Für dich ist KI kein Buzzword und auch kein besseres Google.

Du nutzt AI beispielsweise, um:

technische Fehler systematisch zu analysieren

unbekannte Technologien schneller zu verstehen

Lösungswege zu entwickeln und kritisch zu überprüfen

PowerShell-Skripte oder Automationen zu erstellen

Dokumentationen effizienter aufzubauen

APIs und Systeme miteinander zu verbinden

repetitive Aufgaben zu automatisieren

Dabei kannst du Ergebnisse einer KI technisch einordnen, überprüfen und hinterfragen
.

Du bist neugierig

Wenn du eine Technologie noch nicht kennst, ist deine erste Reaktion nicht:

„Damit habe ich noch nie gearbeitet.“

Sondern:

„Okay. Wie funktioniert das?“

Du hast Freude daran, neue Systeme auszuprobieren, dich selbstständig einzuarbeiten und technische Probleme wirklich zu verstehen.

Du bist Generalist

Du möchtest dich nicht ausschließlich auf einen einzelnen Hersteller oder ein einziges Spezialgebiet beschränken.

Du findest es spannend, Zusammenhänge zwischen Cloud, Netzwerk, Security, Endpoints, Automation und AI
zu verstehen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung

Who We Are

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

About the Role
:

We are looking for an enthusiastic Full Stack .NET Engineer to join our team. You will work in the Researcher Profiles Service
team, where we build and manage a global-scale academic data platform.
Through powerful APIs and intuitive UIs, we make critical research information accessible to the rest of the company and to end-users worldwide.

We have fully embraced AI-based spec-driven design
, integrating AI throughout the entire software development lifecycle. From specification to implementation, AI tooling shapes how we architect, build, and iterate — making us faster, more deliberate, and focused on what matters most. This isn't an experiment. It's how we work.

You will take ownership of high-impact projects and drive them to success in a team that's redefining how modern software is built.

Key Responsibilities
:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance web applications using .NET and Vue.js
Enhance and support existing solutions built with older versions of .NET and Vue.js
Collaborate with product managers, architects, and other cross-functional teams to gather requirements, assess technical feasibility, and determine optimal implementation strategies
Collaborate within a multinational, cross-functional team to deliver software solutions aligned with business needs
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while adhering to best practices
Ensure the quality of the delivered solutions
Optimise applications for performance, scalability, and responsiveness
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges
Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers
Willingness to learn, flexible approach, and staying current with emerging trends in IT to maintain an up-to-date technology stack
Business-oriented attitude with a focus on delivering measurable outcomes for end-users. Demonstrable experience in owning and driving full-stack projects end-to-end, from the specification refinement phase to the production monitoring

Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, specializing in .NET Core/Framework
3+ years of hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks (Vue 3 is a plus)
Familiar with Agile/Scrum methodologies
Deep expertise in Vue.js, including Vue 2 and Vue 3, with a strong understanding of state management, component-based architecture, and best practices for building scalable front-end applications
Strong expertise in SQL Server, including performance tuning, indexing strategies, query optimization, and troubleshooting production issues.
Heavy experience in implementing APIs with REST and GraphQL
Experience integrating AI solutions into customer-facing applications
Proficient in leveraging AI to enhance daily engineering work
Expexienced in owning complex, distributed system architectures
Solid understanding of microservices and micro-frontend concepts
Collaborative and thriving in a hybrid environment

Nice-to-Have Skills
:

Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB)
Experience with containerization platforms (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)

Benefits

We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination - including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. new_jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
new_jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

We are seeking a Solutions Architect to own and drive the technical architecture of our Environmental Accounting product area.

This is a hands-on architecture role, ideal for a technically strong engineer who is ready to take ownership of system design, technical direction, and engineering standards while still contributing to the codebase.

You will play a key role in ensuring the engineering teams consistently deliver value to customers through high-quality, reliable, and scalable SaaS solutions. You will also act as the accountable technical authority for the product area within the wider organization, including Product Management, Engineering leadership, and senior stakeholders.

This role requires a strong software engineering background (ideally .NET / C# or Node.js) with the ability to stay close to the code while shaping architecture and influencing across teams. You should be comfortable working in an environment with minimal unnecessary formality, where success is driven through direct communication, trust, and continuous improvement.

Critically, this role demands deep, demonstrable proficiency with AI.
We are transforming how we build software and what we build. You will be expected to work fluently within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), to architect and deliver agentic AI solutions within our products, and to bring genuine hands-on experience with agentic coding tools — Claude Code in particular. This is not a theoretical or advisory expectation: we are looking for someone who uses these tools daily, understands their failure modes, and can raise the whole engineering organization's capability with them.

Key Responsibilities

Own and evolve the technical architecture

Define, document, and evolve the target architecture for Sphera's Corporate Sustainability product, covering design, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability
Ensure architectural decisions are recorded, justified, and clearly communicated using appropriate modelling and documentation approaches
Build a culture of technical excellence, sound design thinking, and continuous improvement across the engineering teams
Act as the key technical point of reference for the product area, ensuring alignment with broader engineering and business goals

AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC)

Champion and embed an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle across the product area, applying AI meaningfully at every stage — requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and operational support
Define what "good" looks like for AI-assisted engineering: prompting and context practices, human review and verification gates, quality bars, and guardrails for what must never be delegated to a model
Measure the impact of AI on delivery throughput, defect rates, and engineering experience, and iterate on practices based on evidence rather than hype
Establish policy and standards for the safe, secure, and compliant use of AI tooling, including handling of proprietary code, customer data, and intellectual property

Agentic AI solution development

Architect and deliver agentic AI capabilities within Sphera's Environmental Accounting product, taking them from prototype through to production
Design robust agentic systems: tool and function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop controls
Own the non-functional dimensions of AI features — evaluation and testing strategy, observability, latency, cost management, model selection and versioning, and graceful degradation
Address AI-specific risk directly: hallucination and grounding, prompt injection and data exfiltration, access control on agent tooling, auditability, and responsible AI considerations
Maintain a working knowledge of the fast-moving AI landscape and make pragmatic build-versus-buy and model-selection recommendations

Hands-on technical leadership

Contribute directly to the codebase where it has the greatest impact, using modern software engineering practices
Work hands-on with Claude Code and comparable agentic coding tools as a daily part of the role, and set the standard for how the wider team uses them effectively
Extend and tailor the team's AI tooling — for example project context files, custom commands, subagents, hooks, and MCP server integrations with internal systems
Provide deep technical guidance in .NET / C# or Node.js environments
Prototype and validate architectural approaches, spiking on high-risk or high-uncertainty areas ahead of delivery
Maintain a strong, current understanding of system design, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and software quality

Delivery and execution

Partner closely with Product Management to translate requirements into clear, actionable technical designs and engineering outcomes
Ensure architectural work supports consistent, high-quality SaaS releases aligned with business priorities
Identify and remove technical blockers, proactively resolving design and integration issues impacting team performance
Balance long-term architectural health against near-term delivery needs, making trade-offs explicit

Technical influence and enablement

Raise the technical capability of engineers through design reviews, pairing, and mentoring
Upskill the team in AI-assisted engineering, coaching engineers to use agentic tooling with judgment — and to critically review what it produces
Set and champion engineering standards for code quality, testing, observability, and security
Have open, honest, and sometimes challenging technical conversations to drive better outcomes
Foster a culture of informal, direct communication and trust across the teams

Process and continuous improvement

Take ownership of technical practices and evaluate their effectiveness in delivering outcomes
Apply critical judgment to existing designs and processes and propose improvements where needed
Identify and drive down technical debt, prioritizing work that materially improves reliability and speed of delivery
Ensure the teams operate efficiently without unnecessary bureaucracy, while maintaining appropriate engineering discipline

Stakeholder engagement

Act as the primary technical voice for the product area to internal stakeholders and customers where required
Maintain strong working relationships with Product, Engineering, and wider business functions
Ensure transparency in technical direction, risks, and trade-offs

Requirements

Core engineering

7+ years of software engineering experience
3+ years in an architecture, lead engineer, or principal engineer capacity
Strong hands-on development experience in .NET / C# or Node.js
Proven experience architecting and delivering SaaS or enterprise software products at scale
Strong experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS), distributed systems, and API design
Strong ability to translate product requirements into technical designs and execution
Demonstrated experience in mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction without direct authority
Highly desirable: technical proficiency with Databaricks, Sql Server and Azure SQL

AI Proficiency (essential)

Demonstrable hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent agentic coding tools, used routinely on real production codebases rather than experimentally
Practical experience operating within an AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AIDLC), applying AI across design, implementation, testing, review, and documentation — and able to speak credibly about where it works, where it does not, and why
Solid working understanding of agentic AI design patterns — tool/function calling, orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design — with the appetite to take them into production
Working knowledge of the current LLM landscape and the judgment to select models and approaches appropriate to the problem, cost, and latency profile
Experience defining evaluation, testing, and observability strategies for non-deterministic AI systems
Understanding of AI-specific security and governance concerns, including prompt injection, data leakage, access control on agent tooling, and responsible AI practice
Genuine enthusiasm for AI as a force multiplier, balanced with the engineering rigor to know when not to use it

Desirable

Proven experience designing and shipping agentic AI solutions into production, including tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, and human-in-the-loop design
Experience building integrations using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards
Experience introducing AI tooling and practices across an engineering organization, including the change management involved
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, low-formality, high-accountability environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience working in global or cross-functional organizations is beneficial
